metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's one of the best design interfaces of an app that I've ever used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: To me, good design is when everything is easy and natural.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Bad design is when the app gets in the way, either because it's buggy

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or because it tries too hard to be helpful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm looking at you, Clippy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Anyway, there's a big part of my brain and heart that love to design things

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and also to appreciate great design by others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So again, if you get Cash App from the App Store, Google Play,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and use code Lex Podcast, you get 10 dollars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And Cash App will also donate 10 dollars to First,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: an organization that is helping to advance robotics and STEM education

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: for young people around the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And now, here's my conversation with Grant Sanderson.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You've spoken about Richard Feynman as someone you admire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think last time we spoke, we ran out of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I wanted to talk to you about him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Who is Richard Feynman to you in your eyes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: What impact did he have on you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I mean, I think a ton of people like Feynman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's a little bit cliched to say that you like Feynman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That's almost like when you don't know what to say about sports

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and you just point to the Super Bowl or something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: something you enjoy watching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But I do actually think there's a layer to Feynman

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that sits behind the iconography.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: One thing that just really struck me

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: was this letter that he wrote to his wife two years after she died.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So during the Manhattan Project, she had polio.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Tragically, she died.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: They were just young, madly in love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And the icon of Feynman is that he was a young man

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and the icon of Feynman is almost this mildly sexist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: womanizing philanderer, at least on the personal side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But you read this letter, and I can try to pull it up for you if I want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it's just this absolutely heartfelt letter to his wife

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: saying how much he loves her even though she's dead

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and what she means to him, how no woman can ever measure up to her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it shows you that the Feynman that we've all seen

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in like Shirley or Joking is different from the Feynman in reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I think the same kind of goes in his science

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where he kind of sometimes has this output of being this aw-shucks character.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like everyone else is coming in with these fancyfalutin formulas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but I'm just going to try to whittle it down to its essentials,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: which is so appealing because we love to see that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But when you get into it, like, what he was doing was actually quite deep,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: very much mathematical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That should go without saying, but I remember reading a book

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: about Feynman in a cafe once, and this woman looked at me

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and saw that it was about Feynman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: She was like, oh, I love him. I read Shirley or Joking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And she started explaining to me how he was never really a math person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I don't understand how that can possibly be a public perception

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: about any physicist, but for whatever reason, that worked into his or that

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: he sort of shooed off math in place of true science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The reality of it is he was deeply in love with math

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and was much more going in that direction and had a clicking point

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: into seeing that physics was a way to realize that

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and all the creativity that he could output in that direction

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: was instead poured towards things like fundamental,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: not even fundamental theories, just emergent phenomena

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and everything like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So to answer your actual question, like what I like about his way

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of going at things is this constant desire to reinvent it for himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like when he would consume papers the way he'd describe it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: he would start to see what problem he was trying to solve

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then just try to solve it himself to get a sense of personal ownership.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And then from there, see what others had done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Is that how you see problems yourself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That's actually an interesting point when you first are inspired

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: by a certain idea that you maybe want to teach or visualize

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or just explore on your own.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm sure you're captured by some possibility and magic of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Do you read the work of others?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Do you go through the proofs or do you try to rediscover everything yourself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I think the things that I've learned best and have the deepest ownership of

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: are the ones that have some element of rediscovery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The problem is that really slows you down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And for my part, it's actually a big fault.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: This is part of why I'm not an active researcher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm not at the depth of the field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: A lot of other people are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The stuff that I do learn, I try to learn it really well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But other times you do need to get through it at a certain pace.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You do need to get to a point of a problem you're trying to solve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So obviously you need to be well equipped to read things

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: without that reinvention component and see how others have done it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But I think if you choose a few core building blocks along the way

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and you say, I'm really going to try to approach this

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: before I see how this person went at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm really going to try to approach it for myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: No matter what, you gain all sorts of inarticulatable intuitions

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: about that topic, which aren't going to be there

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: if you simply go through the proof.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: For example, you're going to be trying to come up with counter examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You're going to try to come up with intuitive examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: All sorts of things where you're populating your brain with data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And the ones that you come up with are likely to be different

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: than the one that the text comes up with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And that lends at a different angle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So that aspect also slowed Feynman down in a lot of respects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think there was a period when the rest of physics was running away from him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But insofar as it got him to where he was, I kind of resonate with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I would be nowhere near it because I'm not like him at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But it's like a state to aspire to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You know, just to link in a small point you made

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you're not a quote unquote active researcher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You're swimming often in reasonably good depth about a lot of topics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Do you sometimes want to like dive deep at a certain moment

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and say like, because you probably built up a hell of an amazing intuition

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: about what is and isn't true within these worlds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Do you ever want to just dive in and see if you can discover

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: something new?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah. I think one of my biggest regrets from undergrad

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is not having built better relationships with the professors I had there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I think a big part of success in research is that element of mentorship

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and people giving you the kind of scaffolded problems to carry along.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: For my own goals right now, I feel like I'm pretty good at exposing math to others

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and want to continue doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: For my personal learning, are you familiar with the hedgehog fox dynamic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think this was either the ancient Greeks came up with it

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or it was pretended to be something drawn from the ancient Greeks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I don't know who to point it to, but they had probably Mark Twain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It is that you've got two types of people, or especially two types of researchers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: There's the fox that knows many different things

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then the hedgehog that knows one thing very deeply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So like von Neumann would have been the fox.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: He's someone who knows many different things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: just very foundational in a lot of different fields.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Einstein would have been more of a hedgehog,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: thinking really deeply about one particular thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And both are very necessary for making progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So between those two, I would definitely see myself as the fox,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where I'll try to get my paws in a whole bunch of different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And at the moment, I just think I don't know enough of anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to make a significant contribution to any of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But I do see value in having a decently deep understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of a wide variety of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Most people who know computer science really deeply

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: don't necessarily know physics very deeply,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or many of the different fields in math even.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Let's say you have an analytic number theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: versus an algebraic number theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: These two things end up being related to very different fields,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like some of them more complex analysis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: some of them more like algebraic geometry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And then when you just go out so far as to take those adjacent fields,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: place one PhD student into a seminar of another one,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: they don't understand what the other one's saying at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like you take the complex analysis specialist

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: inside the algebraic geometry seminar,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But I think going around and trying to have some sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of what this big picture is certainly has personal value for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I don't know if I would ever make new contributions in those fields,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but I do think I could make new expositional contributions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where there's kind of a notion of things that are known

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but haven't been explained very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Well, first of all, I think most people would agree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Your videos, your teaching, the way you see the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is fundamentally often new.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like you're creating something new.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it almost feels like research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Even just like the visualizations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: the multidimensional visualization we'll talk about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I mean, you're revealing something very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That, yeah, just feels like research, feels like science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: feels like the cutting edge of the very thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of which new ideas and new discoveries are made of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I do think you're being a little bit more generous than is necessarily.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I promise that's not even false humility,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because I sometimes think when I research a video,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'll learn 10 times as much as I need for the video itself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and it ends up feeling kind of elementary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I have a sense of just how far away

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: the stuff that I cover is from the actual depth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think that's natural, but I think that could also be a mathematics thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I feel like in the machine learning world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you're like two weeks in, you feel like you've basically mastered the field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: In mathematics, it's like...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Well, everything is either trivial or impossible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it's like a shockingly thin line between the two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where you can find something that's totally impenetrable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then after you get a feel for it, it's like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: oh yeah, that whole subject is actually trivial in some way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So maybe that's what goes on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Every researcher is just on the other end of that hump,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and it feels like it's so far away, but one step actually gets them there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: What do you think about Feynman's teaching style,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or another perspective of use of visualization?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Well, his teaching style is interesting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because people have described the Feynman effect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where while you're watching his lectures,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or while you're reading his lectures, everything makes such perfect sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So as an entertainment session, it's wonderful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because it gives you this intellectual satisfaction

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you don't get from anywhere else,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you finally understand it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But the Feynman effect is that you can't really recall

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what it is that gave you that insight, even a week later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And this is true of a lot of books and a lot of lectures,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where the retention isn't ever quite what we hope it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So there is a risk that the stuff that I do also fits that same bill,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where at best it's giving this kind of intellectual candy

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: on giving a glimpse of feeling like you understand something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But unless you do something active,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like reinventing it yourself, like doing problems to solidify it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: even things like space repetition memory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to just make sure that you have the building blocks

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of what do all the terms mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: unless you're doing something like that, it's not actually going to stick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So the very same thing that's so admirable about Feynman's lectures,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: which is how damn satisfying they are to consume,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: might actually also reveal a little bit of the flaw

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that we should, as educators, all look out for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: which is that that does not correlate with long-term learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: We'll talk about it a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You've done some interactive stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Even in your videos,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: the awesome thing that Feynman couldn't do at the time

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is you could, since it's programmed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you can tinker, play with stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You can take this value and change it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You can like, here, let's take the value of this variable and change it

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to build up an intuition, to move along the surface,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to change the shape of something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think that's almost an equivalent of you doing it yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's not quite there, but as a viewer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, do you think there's some value in that interactive element?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, well, so what's interesting is you're saying that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and the videos are non-interactive in the sense that there's a play button

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and a pause button, and you could ask, hey, while you're programming these things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: why don't you program it into an interactable version,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: make it a Jupyter Notebook that people can play with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: which I should do, and that would be better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think the thing about interactives, though, is most people consuming them

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: just sort of consume what the author had in mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And that's kind of what they want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I have a ton of friends who make interactive explanations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And when you look into the analytics of how people use them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: there's a small sliver that genuinely use it as a playground to have experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And maybe that small sliver is actually who you're targeting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and the rest don't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But most people consume it just as a piece of well-constructed literature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that maybe you tweak with the example a little bit to see what it's getting at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But in that way, I do think a video can get most of the benefits of the interactive app,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: as long as you make the interactive for yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and you decide what the best narrative to spin is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: As a more concrete example, like my process with...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I made this video about SIR models for epidemics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it's like this agent-based bottling thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where you tweak some things about how the epidemic spreads,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and you want to see how that affects its evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: My format for making that was very different than others,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where rather than scripting it ahead of time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I just made the playground, and then I played a bunch,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then I saw what stories there were to tell within that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, that's cool. So your video had that kind of structure.

body.input: It had like five or six stories or whatever it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: so that you can go to that website

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and you can test your own hypotheses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is not just the technology, but to give the story around it as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And that's kind of my job.

body.input: exponential growth pattern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: As it goes on, and let's say it's something endemic

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where you've got, like, a ton of people who have had it

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and are recovered, then you would...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because a lot of the people you interact with

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: aren't susceptible, but in the early phases, it does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And this is, like, the fundamental constant

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is to get that down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And if it's above one, then you're epidemic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So, like, just teaching what that value is

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I mean, another way to ask, like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: do you think we're able to reason intuitively

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: about exponential growth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's funny. I think it's extremely intuitive to humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then we train it out of ourselves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And then I think it can become intuitive again

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: when you study a technical field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So what I mean by that is, um...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Have you ever heard of these studies where,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in a, like, anthropological setting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where you're studying a group that has been disassociated

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: from a lot of, like, modern society,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And maybe you would ask, you've got, like, one rock

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That's the number that sits right between one and nine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But sometimes when numeracy and the kind of just basic arithmetic

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that we have isn't in a society, the natural instinct is three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Because it's in between, in an exponential sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in a geometric sense, that one is three times bigger

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then the next one is three times bigger than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in between those two states.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to think logarithmically like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to start thinking linearly about things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So in the sense, yeah, the early, early basic math

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is, uh, yeah, forces us to take a step back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that we understand everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: We get hot dogs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That was never...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, people ask me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what's the favorite interview you've ever done?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I mean, that has to be...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118
