body.input: Knuth dogs. Sorry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So that was a little bragging,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but the hot dogs, it's such a sweet, so...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But the reason I bring that up is he works through problems alone as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: He prefers that struggle, the struggle of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You know, writers like Stephen King,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you know, often talk about, like, their process of, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what they do, like, what they eat when they wake up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like, when they sit down, like, how they like their desk,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you know, on a perfectly productive day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, what they like to do, how long they like to work for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what enables them to think deeply, all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Hunter Stompson did a lot of drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Everybody has their own thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: What's... Do you have a thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Is there...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: If you were to lay out a perfect, productive day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what would that schedule look like, do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Part of that's hard to answer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because, like, the mode of work I do changes a lot from day to day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, some days I'm writing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The thing I have to do is write a script.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Some days I'm animating. The thing I have to do is animate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Sometimes I'm, like, working on the animation library.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The thing I have to do is, like, a little...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm not a software engineer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but something in the direction of software engineering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Some days it's, like, a variant of research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's, like, learn this topic well and try to learn it differently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So those are, like, four very different modes of what it...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Some days it's, like, get through the email backlog

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of people I've been...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The tasks I've been putting off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It goes research, scripting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, the idea starts with research and then there's scripting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then there's programming, and then there's the showtime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And the research side, by the way, like, what's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think a problematic way to do it is to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm starting this project, and therefore I'm starting the research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Instead, it should be that you're, like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: ambiently learning a ton of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: just in the background.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And then once you feel like you have the understanding for one,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you put it on the list of things that there can be a video for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Otherwise, either you're gonna end up roadblocked forever

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or you're just not gonna, like, have a good way of talking about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But still, some of the days,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: it's, like, the thing to do is learn new things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So what's the most painful one?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think you mentioned scripting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Scripting is... Yeah, that's the worst.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, writing is the worst.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So what's your... On a perfectly...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So let's take the hardest one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: What's a perfectly productive day?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You wake up and it's like, damn it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: this is the day I need to do some scripting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And, like, you didn't do anything the last two days,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: so you came up with excuses to procrastinate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: so today must be the day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, I wake up early, I guess I exercise,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then I turn the internet off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Uh... If we're writing, yeah, that's what's required,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is having the internet off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And then maybe you keep notes on the things that you wanna Google

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: when you're allowed to have the internet again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm not great about doing that, but when I do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that makes it happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And then when I hit writer's block,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like, the solution to writer's block is to read.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Doesn't even have to be related, just read something different,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: just for, like, 15 minutes, half an hour,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and then go back to writing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That, when it's a nice cycle, I think can work very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And when you're writing the script,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you don't know where it ends, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, you have a...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, problem-solving videos, I know where it ends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Expositional videos, I don't know where it ends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And coming up with the magical thing that makes this whole story,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like, ties this whole story together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: When does that happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That's the thing that makes it such that a topic gets put on the list

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of, like, videos to actually make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, you shouldn't start the project unless there's one of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Ah, and you have so many nice bags,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you have such a big bag of aha moments already

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you could just pull at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That's one of the things, and one of the...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: sad things about time, and that nothing lasts forever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and that we're all mortal, let's not get into that...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Um...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: ...discussion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Uh, is, you know, if I see, like...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Even when I ask for people to ask, like, ask...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I did a call for questions, and people want to ask you questions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and you have so many requests from people about, like, certain videos

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: they would love you to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's such a pile, and...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think that's a sign of, like, admiration from people, for sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But it's like, it makes me sad, because, like, whenever I see them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: people give ideas, they're all, like, very often really good ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it's like...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's such a...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Makes me sad in the same kind of way when I go through a library

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or through a bookstore, you see all these amazing books

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you'll never get to open.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So, yeah, so you do, yeah...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You gotta enjoy the ones that you have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Enjoy the books that are open,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and don't let yourself lament the ones that stay closed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: What else? Is there any other magic to that day?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Do you try to dedicate, like, a certain number of hours?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Do you, uh...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Cal Newport has this deep work kind of idea?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm... There's systematic people who, like, get really on top of, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: they checklist of what they're gonna do in the day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and they, like, count their hours,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and I am not a systematic person in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's... Which is probably a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I very likely would get more done if I was systematic in that way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but that doesn't happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So, you know, you talk to me later in life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and maybe I'll have, like, changed my ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and give you a very different answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think Benjamin Franklin, like, later in life figured out the rigor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: He has these, like, very rigorous schedules on what...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: How to be productive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think those schedules are much more fun to write.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, it's very fun to, like, write a schedule

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and make a blog post about, like, the perfect productive day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Um, that, like, might work for one person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but I don't know how much people get out of, like, reading them

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or trying to adopt someone else's style.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I'm not even sure that they've ever followed...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, exactly. Like, you're always gonna write it

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: as the best version of yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Um, you're not going to, uh, explain the phenomenon

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of, like, wanting to get out of the bed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but not really wanting to get out of the bed and all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And just, like, zoning out for random reasons or...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I guess it doesn't surprise me that it's bad at numerical patterns

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because maybe I should be more impressed with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But like that requires having a weird combination of intuitive

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and formulaic worldview.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So you're not just going off of intuition

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: when you see Fibonacci numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You're not saying like intuitively, what do I think will follow the 13?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like I've seen patterns a lot where like 13s are followed by 21s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Instead, it's the way you're starting to see a shape of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is by knowing what hypotheses to test,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where you're saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: oh, maybe it's generated based on the previous terms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or maybe it's generated based on like multiplying by a constant

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or whatever it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You like have a bunch of different hypotheses

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and your intuitions are around those hypotheses,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but you still need to actively test it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it seems like GPT-3 is extremely good at

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like that sort of pattern matching recognition

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that usually is very hard for computers

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that is what humans get good at

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: through expertise and exposure to lots of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's why it's good to learn from as many examples as you can

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: rather than just from the definitions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's to get that level of intuition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But to actually concretize it into a piece of math,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you do need to like test your hypotheses

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and if not prove it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like have an actual explanation for what's going on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: not just a pattern that you've seen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, but then the flip side to play devil's advocate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that's a very kind of probably correct intuitive understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of just like we said, a few layers creating abstractions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But it's been able to form something that looks like

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: a compression of the data that it's seen

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that looks awfully a lot like it understands

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what the heck it's talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Well, I think a lot of understanding is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like I don't mean to denigrate pattern recognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Pattern recognition is most of understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and it's super important and it's super hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And so like when it's demonstrating this kind of real understanding,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: compressing down some data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like that might be pattern recognition at its finest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: My only point would be that like what differentiates math,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think to a large extent is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: the pattern recognition isn't sufficient

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and that the kind of patterns that you're recognizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: are not like the end goals, but instead they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: they are the little bits and paths that get you to the end goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That's certainly true for mathematics in general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's an interesting question if that might

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: for certain kinds of series of numbers, it might not be true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like you might, because that's a basic, you know, like Taylor's,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like certain kinds of series, it feels like compressing the internet

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is enough to figure out, because those patterns in some form

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: appear in the text somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Well, I mean, there's all sorts of wonderful examples

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of false patterns in math where one of the earliest videos

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I put on the channel was talking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you kind of dividing a circle up using these chords

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and you see this pattern of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I was like, okay, pretty easy to see what that pattern is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's powers of two. You've seen it a million times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But it's not powers of two. The next term is 31.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And so it's like almost a power of two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but it's a little bit shy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And there's actually a very good explanation for what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But I think it's a good test of whether you're thinking clearly

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: about mechanistic explanations of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: how quickly you jump to thinking it must be powers of two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Because the problem itself, there's really no good way to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I mean, there can't be a good way to think about it as like doubling a set

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because ultimately it doesn't. But even before it starts to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: it's not something that screams out as being a doubling phenomenon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So at best, if it did turn out to be powers of two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: it would have only been so very subtly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I think the difference between a math student making the mistake

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and a mathematician who's experienced seeing that kind of pattern

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is that they'll have a sense from what the problem itself is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: whether the pattern that they're observing is reasonable and how to test it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I would just be very impressed if there was any algorithm

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that was actively accomplishing that goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, like a learning-based algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like a little scientist, I guess, basically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's a fascinating thought because GPT-3,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: these language models are already accomplishing way more than I've expected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I'm learning not to doubt...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I bet we'll get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, I'm not saying I'd be impressed, but like surprised.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like I'll be impressed, but I think we'll get there on algorithms doing math like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So one of the amazing things you've done for the world is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to some degree, open-sourcing the tooling that you use to make your videos

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: with Manum, this Python library.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Now, it's quickly evolving because I think you're inventing new things

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: every time you make a video.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: In fact, I've been working on playing around with something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I wanted to do like an ode to 3BlueOnBrown.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I love playing Hendrix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I saw that you had a little piece of code on like Mobius strip.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I tried to do some cool things with spinning a Mobius strip,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like continue...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: twisting it, I guess is the term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it was easier to... It was tough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I haven't figured it out yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I guess the question I want to ask is so many people love it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you've put that out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: They want to do the same thing as I do with Hendrix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: They want to cover it. They want to explain an idea using the tool,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: including Rust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: How would you recommend they try to... I'm very sorry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: They try to go by about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And what kind of choices should they choose to be most effective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That I can answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I always feel guilty if this comes up because I think of it like this scrappy tool

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that's like a math teacher who put together some code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: People asked what it was. So they made it open source.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And they kept scrapping it together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And there's a lot of things about it that make it harder to work with

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: than it needs to be that are a function of me not being a software engineer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I've put some work this year trying to make it better and more flexible

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that is still just kind of like a work in process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: One thing I would love to do is just get my act together

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: about properly integrating with what the community wants to work with

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and what stuff I work on and making that not deviate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And just actually fostering that community

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in a way that I've been shamefully neglectful of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I'm just always guilty if it comes up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So let's put that guilt aside. Just kind of Zen-like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'll pretend like it isn't terrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: For someone like Russ, I think step one is like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: make sure that what you're animating should be done so programmatically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Because a lot of things maybe shouldn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like if you're just making a quick graph of something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: if it's a graphical intuition that maybe has a little motion to it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: use Desmos, use Grapher, use Geogebra, use Mathematica.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Certain things that are really oriented around graphs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Geogebra is kind of cool. It's amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You can get very, very far with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And in a lot of ways, it would make more sense for some stuff that I do

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to just do in Geogebra.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But I kind of have this cycle of liking to try to improve Manim

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: by doing videos and such. So do as I say, not as I do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The original thought I had in making Manim was

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that there's so many different ways of representing functions

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: other than graphs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: In particular, things like transformations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Use movement over time to communicate relationships

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: between inputs and outputs instead of X direction and Y direction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Or like vector fields or things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I wanted something that was flexible enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you didn't feel constrained into a graphical environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But also make sure that you're taking advantage of the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: than they should be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Because the problem is whether we're talking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: trying to make sense of Weinstein's lectures

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or Wolfram's project, or let's just say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: listening to Witten talk about string theory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: whatever proposed path to a theory of everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you're not actually going to understand it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: going to understand the substance of what they're saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: What I think is way, way more productive

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is to let yourself get really interested in the phenomena

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that are still deep, but which you have a chance of understanding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Because the path to getting to even understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what questions these theories of everything are trying to answer

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: involves walking down that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I mean, I was watching a video before I came here

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: from Steve Mould talking about why sugar polarizes light

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in a certain way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So fascinating, like really, really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's not like this novel theory of everything type thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But to understand what's going on there

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: really requires digging in in depth to certain ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And if you let yourself think past what the video tells you about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what does circularly polarized light mean and things like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: it actually would get you to a pretty good appreciation

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of like two state states and quantum systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in a way that just trying to read about like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: oh, what are the hard parts about resolving quantum field theories

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: with general relativity is never going to get you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So as far as popularizing science is concerned,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like the audience should be less interested

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: than they are in theories of everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The popularizers should be less emphatic than they are about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: For like actual practicing physicists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: it might be the case maybe more people should think

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: about fundamental questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But it's difficult to create like a three blue one brown video

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: on the theory of everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So basically, we should really try to find the beauty

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in mathematics or physics by looking at concepts

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that are like within reach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, I think that's super important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I mean, so you see this in math too with the big unsolved problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So like the clay millennium problems, Riemann hypothesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Have you ever done a video on Fermat's last theorem?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But if I did, do you know what I would do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I would talk about proving Fermat's last theorem

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in the specific case of n equals three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Is that still accessible though?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yes, actually, barely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Mathologer might be able to do like a great job on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: He does a good job of taking stuff that's barely accessible and making it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But the core ideas of proving it for n equals three are hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But they do get you real ideas about algebraic number theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It involves looking at a number field that's,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: it lives in the complex plane.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It looks like a hexagonal lattice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And you start asking questions about factoring numbers

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in this hexagonal lattice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So it takes a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But I've talked about this sort of like lattice arithmetic in other contexts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And you can get to a okay understanding of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And the things that make Fermat's last theorem hard

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: are actually quite deep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And so the cases that we can solve it for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: it's like you can get these broad sweeps based on some hard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but like accessible bits of number theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But before you can even understand why the general case is as hard as it is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you have to walk through those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And so any other attempt to describe it would just end up being like shallow

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and not really productive for the viewer's time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think the same goes for most like unsolved problem type things

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where I think, you know, as a kid,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I was actually very inspired by the twin prime conjecture

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that like totally sucked me in as this thing that was understandable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I kind of had this dream like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: oh, maybe I'll be the one to prove the twin prime conjecture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And new math that I would learn would be like viewed

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: through this lens of like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: oh, maybe I can apply it to that in some way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But you sort of mature to a point where you realize

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you should spend your brain cycles on problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you will see resolved

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because then you're going to grow to see what it feels like

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: for these things to be resolved

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: rather than spending your brain cycles on something

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: where it's not going to pan out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And the people who do make progress towards these things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like James Maynard is a great example here

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: of like young creative mathematician

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: who like pushes in the direction of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like the twin prime conjecture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Rather than hitting that head on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: just see all the interesting questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that are hard for similar reasons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but become more tractable

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and let themselves really engage with those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So I think people should get in that habit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think the popularization of physics

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: should encourage that habit

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: through things like the physics of simple everyday phenomena

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: because it can get quite deep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And yeah, I think, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I've heard a lot of the interest that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118
