metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or asking to explain Wolfram's thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: One, I don't understand them, but more importantly...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's too big a bite to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You shouldn't be interested in those, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The giant sort of ball of interesting ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: There's probably a million of interesting ideas in there

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that individually could be explored effectively.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And to be clear, you should be interested in fundamental questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think that's a good habit to ask what the fundamentals of things are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But I think it takes a lot of steps to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, certainly you shouldn't be trying to answer that

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: unless you actually understand quantum field theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and you actually understand general relativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: That's the cool thing about, like, your videos,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: people who haven't done mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, if you really give it time, watch it a couple of times

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and, like, try to reason about it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: you can actually understand the concept that's being explained.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And it's not a coincidence that the things I'm describing aren't,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: like, the most up-to-date progress

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: on the Riemann hypothesis cousins,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: or, like, there's context in which the analogue of the Riemann hypothesis

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: has been solved in, like, more discrete feeling finite settings

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that are more well-behaved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I'm not describing that because it just takes a ton to get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And instead, I think it'll be, like, productive

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: to have an actual understanding of something

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that you can pack into 20 minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think that's beautifully put.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Ultimately, that's where, like, the most satisfying thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: is when you really understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Um, yeah, really understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Build a habit of feeling what it's like to actually come to resolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: As opposed to... which it can also be enjoyable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: No, you didn't. I'm just joking. It was great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I don't think life has a meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think, like, meaning... I don't understand the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think meaning is something that's described to stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that's created with purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: There's a meaning to, like, this water bottle label,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in that someone created it with the purpose of conveying meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And there was, like, one consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: that wanted to get its ideas into another consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Um...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Most things don't have that property.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It's a little bit like if I asked you, like, what is the height?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Right. So it's all relative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Yeah, you'd be like, the height of what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You can't ask what is the height without an object.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You can't ask what is the meaning of life

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: without, like, an intentful consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: putting it, like... I guess I'm revealing I'm not very religious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But, you know, the mathematics of everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: seems kind of beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It seems like...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It seems like there's some kind of structure

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: relative to which, I mean, you could calculate the height.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Well, but what I'm saying is, I don't understand the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what is the meaning of life, in that I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: people might be asking something very real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I don't understand what they're asking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Are they asking, like, why does life exist?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, how did it come about? What are the natural laws?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Are they asking, um...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: As I'm making decisions day by day for what should I do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what is the guiding light that inspires, like, what should I do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think that's what people are kind of asking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: But also, like, why...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The thing that gives you joy about education, about mathematics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: what the hell is that? Like, what...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Interactions with other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Interactions with like-minded people, I think, is the meaning of...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: In that sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Bringing others joy, essentially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, in something you've created,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: it connects with others somehow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And the same in the vice versa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Mm-hmm. I think that is what, um...

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: When we use the word meaning to mean, like, you're sort of filled

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: with a sense of happiness and energy to create more things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, I have so much meaning taken from this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Like, that, yeah, that's what fuels my pump, at least.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: So, life alone on a deserted island would be kind of meaningless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You want to be alone together with someone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think we're all alone together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I think there's no better way to end it, Grant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: You've been... First time we talked, it was amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Again, it's a huge honor that you make time for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I appreciate talking with you. Thanks, man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And now, let me leave you with some words from Richard Feynman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I have a friend who's an artist and has sometimes taken a view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: which I don't agree with very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: He'll hold up a flower and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: look how beautiful it is, and I'll agree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Then he says, I, as an artist, can see how beautiful this is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: but you, as a scientist, take this all apart

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and it becomes a dull thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: And I think he's kind of nutty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: First of all, the beauty that he sees is available to other people

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: and to me, too, I believe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Although I may not be quite as refined aesthetically as he is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I can appreciate the beauty of a flower.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: At the same time, I see much more about the flower than he sees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I can imagine the cells in there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: the complicated actions inside, which also have a beauty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I mean, it's not just beauty at this dimension at one centimeter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: There's also beauty at smaller dimensions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The inner structure, also the processes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: The fact that the colors in the flower evolved

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: in order to attract insects to pollinate it is interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It means that insects can see the color.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It adds a question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Does this aesthetic sense also exist in the lower forms?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Why is it aesthetic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: All kinds of interesting questions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: which the science knowledge only adds to the excitement,

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: the mystery, and the awe of a flower.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: It only adds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: I don't understand how it subtracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118

body.input: Thank you for listening and hope to see you next time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice and Yaron Brook: Ayn Rand, Human Nature, and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #178

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice and Yaron Brook: Ayn Rand, Human Nature, and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #178

body.input: in rare cases saying something humorous, including dark humor, especially in Michael's case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice and Yaron Brook: Ayn Rand, Human Nature, and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #178

body.input: All three of us are sensitive to the suffering in the world today and throughout human history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice and Yaron Brook: Ayn Rand, Human Nature, and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #178

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice and Yaron Brook: Ayn Rand, Human Nature, and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #178

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice and Yaron Brook: Ayn Rand, Human Nature, and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #178

body.input: people is to realize that this escalating arms race of more things will solve your problems is not true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: More and better is not the solution. It's this idea that you are on a very precise journey

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: that's unique to yourself. You are playing a game of which only you are the player.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Everybody else is an interloper, and you have a responsibility to design the gameplay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: And I think a lot of people don't realize that because if they did, I think they would make a

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: lot of different decisions about how they live their life. And I still do the same thing. I mean

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: revert to basically running around asking other people, what will make you like me more? What will

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: make me more popular in your eyes? And I try to do it, and it never works. It is just a complete

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: dead end. Is there negative aspects to money? Like for example, it becoming harder to find people

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: you can trust. I think the most negative aspect is that it amplifies a 360 degree view of your

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: personality. Because there are a lot of people and society tells you that more money is actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: better. You are a better person somehow, and you're factually more worthwhile than some other people

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: that have less money. That's also a lie. But when you're given that kind of attention, it's very

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: easy for you to become a caricature of yourself. That's probably the single worst thing that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: happens to you. But I say it in the opposite way. I think all I've ever seen in Silicon Valley as

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: an example, is that when somebody gets a hold of a lot of money, it tends to cause them to become

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: exactly who they were meant to be. They're either a kind person, they're either a curious person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: they're either a jerk, they're either cheap. And they can use all kinds of masks, but now that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: there's no expectations and society gives you a get out of jail free card, you still have to

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: get out of jail free card, you start to behave the way that's most comfortable to you. So you see

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: somebody's innate personality. And that's a really interesting thing to observe because then you can

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: very quickly bucket sort, where do you want to spend time and who is really additive to your

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: gameplay and who is really a negative detractor to your gameplay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: You're an investor, but you're also a kind of philosopher. You analyze the world in all

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: different perspectives on all in podcasts, on Twitter, everywhere. Do you worry that money

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: puts you out of touch from being able to truly empathize with the experience of the general

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: population, which in part, first of all, on a human level that could be limiting, but also as an

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: analyst of human civilization that could be limiting? I think it definitely can for a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: of people because it's an abstraction for you to stop caring. I also think the other thing is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: you can very quickly, especially in today's world, become the scapegoat just to use a

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Girardian like René Girard. If you think about mimetic theory in a nutshell,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: we're all competing for these very scarce resources that we are told is worthwhile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: If you view the world through that Girardian lens, what are we really doing? We are all fighting for

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: scarce resources, whether that's Twitter followers, money, acclaim, notoriety, and we all compete with

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: each other. In that competition, Girard writes, the only way you escape that loop is by scapegoating

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: something or somebody. I think we are in that loop right now where just the fact of being

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: successful is a thing that one should scapegoat to end all of this tension that we have in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: world. I think that it's a little misguided because I don't think it solves the fundamental problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: We can talk about what the solution to some of these problems are, but that's, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: the loop that we're all living. If you become a caricature and you feed yourself into it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: you're not doing anything to really advance things. Your nickname is the dictator. How did you get the

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: nickname? We're talking about the corrupting nature of money. That came from poker. In a poker game,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: when you sit down, it's chaos, especially in our home game. There's a ton of big egos. There's

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: people always watching, rail-birding the game, all kinds of interesting folks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: All kinds of interesting folks. In that, somebody needs to establish hygiene and rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: I really care about the integrity of the game. It would just require somebody to just say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: okay, enough. Then people were just like, okay, stop dictating. That's where that dictated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: So who to you, speaking of which, is the greatest poker player of all time and why is it Phil Hell

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Muth? Exactly. Muth probably knew this question was coming. Here's what I'll say. I think Hell

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Muth is the antidote to computers more than any other player playing today. When you see him

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: in a heads up situation, so I think he's played nine or 10 heads up tournaments in a row,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: and he's played basically, call it 10 of the top 20 people so far, and he's beaten all but one of

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: them. When you're playing heads up, 1v1, that is the most GTO understandable spot, meaning game

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: theory optimal position. That's where computers can give you an enormous edge. The minute you add

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: even a third player, the value of computers and the value of their recommendations basically falls

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: off a cliff. One way to think about it is Hell Muth is forced to play against people that are

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: essentially trained like AIs. So to be able to beat eight out of nine of them means that you

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: are playing sort of orthogonally to what is considered game theory optimal and you're overlaying

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: human reasoning. The judgment to say, well, in this spot, I should do X, but I'm going to do Y.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: It's not dissimilar in chess like what makes Magnus Carlsen so good. Sometimes he takes these

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: weird lines, he'll sacrifice positions, he'll overplay certain positions or certain bishops

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: versus knights in all of these spots that are very confusing. What it does is it throws people off

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: their game. I think he just won a recent online tournament and it's like by move six, there is no

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: GTO move for his opponent to make because it's out of the rule book. Maybe he read some game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: I read the quote, it was like, he probably read some game in some bar in Russia in 1954, memorized

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: it and all of a sudden by six moves in, the computer AI is worthless. So that's what makes

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Hell Muth great. There is one person that I think is superior and I think it's what Daniel also said

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: and I would echo that because I played Phil as well, but Phil Ivy is the most well-rounded,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: cold-blooded, bloodthirsty animal. He sees into your soul, Lex, in a way where you're just like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: oh my God, stop looking at me. Have you ever played him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Yeah. Yeah, we've played. We've played and he crushes the games, crushes the games.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: So what does feeling crushed mean and feel like in poker? Is it like that you just can't read at

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: all, you're being constantly pressured, you feel off balance, you try to bluff and the person reads

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: you perfectly, that kind of stuff? It's a really, really excellent question

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: because I think this has parallels to a bunch of other things. Okay, let's just use poker as a

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: microcosm to explain a bunch of other systems or games. Maybe it's running a company or investing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Okay, so let's use those three examples, but we use poker to explain it. What does success look

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: like? Well, success looks like you have positive expected value. In poker, the simple way to

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: summarize that is your opponent, let's just say you and I are playing, are going to make a bunch of

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: mistakes. There's a bunch of it that's going to be absolutely perfect and then there's a few spots

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: where you make mistakes. And then there's a bunch of places in the poker game where I play perfectly

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: and I make a few mistakes. Basically, your mistakes minus my mistakes is the edge, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: That's how poker works. If I make fewer mistakes than you make, I will make money and I will win.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: That is the objective of the game. Translate that into business. You're running a company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: You have a team of employees. You have a pool of human capital that's capable of being productive

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: in the world and creating something, but you are going to make mistakes in making that. Maybe it

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: doesn't completely fit the market. Maybe it's mispriced. Maybe it actually doesn't require all

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: of the people that you need, so the margins are wrong. And then there's the competitive set of

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: all the other alternatives that customer has. Their mistakes minus your mistakes is the expected

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: value of Google, Facebook, Apple, etc. Okay, now take investing. Every time you buy something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: somebody else on the other side is selling it to you. Is that their mistake? We don't know yet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: but their mistakes minus your mistakes is how you make a lot of money over long periods of time as

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: an investor. Somebody sold you Google at $40 a share. You bought it and you kept it. Huge mistake

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: on their part, minimum mistakes on your part. The difference of that is the money that you made.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: So life can be summarized in many ways in that way. So the question is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: what can you do about other people's mistakes? And the answer is nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: That is somebody else's game. You can try to influence them. You could try to subvert them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Maybe you plant a spy inside of that other person's company to sabotage them. I guess there are things

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: at the edges that you can do. But my firm belief is that life success really boils down to how do

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: you control your mistakes? Now, this is a bit counterintuitive. The way you control your mistakes

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: is by making a lot of mistakes. So taking risks is somehow a way to minimize the number of mistakes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Let's just say you want to find love. You want to find somebody you're deeply connected with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Do you do that by not going out on dates? Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Sorry. Sorry. You're the only person that thinks that's the answer to that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: I'm joking. I'm joking. You know what I mean? You have to date people. You have to open yourself up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: You have to be authentic. You give yourself a chance to get hurt. But you're a good person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: So you know what happens when you get hurt? That is actually their mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: Okay? And if you are inauthentic, that's your mistake. That's a controllable thing in you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: You can tell them the truth, who you are, and say, here's my pluses and minuses. My point is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: there are very few things in life that you can't break down, I think, into that very simple idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: And in terms of your mistakes, society tells you don't make them, because we will judge you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: and we will look down on you. And I think the really successful people realize that actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: know it's the cycle time of mistakes that gets you to success. Because your error rate will

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: diminish the more mistakes that you make. You observe them. You figure out where it's coming

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: from. Is it a psychological thing? Is it a cognitive thing? And then you fix it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: So the implied thing there is that there's, in business and investing, in poker, in dating,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: in life, is that there's this platonic GTO, game theory, optimal thing out there. And so when you

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: say mistakes, you're always comparing to that optimal path you could have taken.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: I think slightly different. I would say mistake is maybe a bad proxy, but it's the best proxy

metadata.title: Podcast: Chamath Palihapitiya: Money, Success, Startups, Energy, Poker & Happiness | Lex Fridman Podcast #338

body.input: I have for learning. But I'm using the language of what society tells you.

body.input: As a side note, let me say a few words about the dissemination of scientific ideas. I believe that

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: all scientific articles should be freely accessible to the public. They currently are not. In one

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: analysis I saw, more than 70% of published research articles are behind a paywall. In case you don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: know, the funders of the research, whether that's government or industry, aren't the ones putting

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: up the paywall. The journals are the ones putting up the paywall while using unpaid labor from

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: researchers for the peer review process. Where is all that money from the paywall going?

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: In this digital age, the costs here should be minimal. This cost can easily be covered through

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: donation, advertisement, or public funding of science. The benefit versus the cost of all

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: papers being free to read is obvious. And the fact that they're not free goes against everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: science should stand for, which is the free dissemination of ideas that educate and inspire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: Science cannot be a gated institution. The more people can freely learn and collaborate on ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: the more problems we can solve in the world together. And the faster we can drive old ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Luís and João Batalha: Fermat's Library and the Art of Studying Papers | Lex Fridman Podcast #209

body.input: out and bring new, better ideas in. Science is beautiful and powerful. And its dissemination
