body.input: Yeah, that's an experiment that I don't believe we've done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And if we have, I don't want to know about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We'll collaborate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I can take on the lead on that effort.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Okay, cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: How does the cells coordinate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Let's focus in on just the embryogenesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So there's one cell, so it divides, doesn't have to be very careful about what each cell

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: starts doing once they divide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: When there's three of them, it's like the co-founders or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Slow down, you're responsible for this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: When do they become specialized and how do they coordinate that specialization?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So this is the basic science of developmental biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's a lot known about all of that, but I'll tell you what I think is kind of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: most important part, which is yes, it's very important who does what.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: However, because going back to this issue of why I made this claim that biology doesn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: take the past too seriously and what I mean by that is it doesn't assume that everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: is the way it's expected to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And here's an example of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This was done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This was an old experiment going back to the 40s, but basically imagine it's a newt, a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: salamander, and it's got these little tubules that go to the kidneys, this little tube.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Take a cross-section of that tube, you see 8 to 10 cells that have cooperated to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: this little tube in cross-section.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So one amazing thing you can do is you can mess with the very early cell division to

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: make the cells gigantic, bigger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can make them different sizes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can force them to be different sizes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So if you make the cells different sizes, the whole newt is still the same size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So if you take a cross-section through that tubule, instead of 8 to 10 cells, you might

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: have 4 or 5 or you might have 3, until you make the cell so enormous that one single

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: cell wraps around itself and gives you that same large-scale structure with a completely

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: different molecular mechanism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So now instead of cell-to-cell communication to make a tubule, instead of that, it's one

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: cell using the cytoskeleton to bend itself around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So think about what that means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: In the service of a large-scale, talk about top-down control, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: In the service of a large-scale anatomical feature, different molecular mechanisms get

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: called up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So now think about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You're a newt cell and trying to make an embryo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you had a fixed idea of who was supposed to do what, you'd be screwed because now your

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: cells are gigantic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Nothing would work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's an incredible tolerance for changes in the size of the parts and the amount of

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: DNA in those parts, all sorts of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The life is highly interoperable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can put electrodes in there and you can put weird nanomaterials.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It still works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This is that problem-solving action, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's able to do what it needs to do even when circumstances change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That is the hallmark of intelligence, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: William James defined intelligence as the ability to get to the same goal by different

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You get to the same goal by completely different means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so why am I bringing this up is just to say that, yeah, it's important for the cells

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to do the right stuff, but they have incredible tolerances for things not being what you expect

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and to still get their job done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So if you're...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: All of these things are not hardwired.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There are organisms that might be hardwired.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: For example, the nematode C. elegans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: In that organism, every cell is numbered, meaning that every C. elegans has exactly

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the same number of cells as every other C. elegans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They're all in the same place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They all divide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's literally a map of how it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: In that sort of system, it's much more cookie cutter, but most organisms are incredibly

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: plastic in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Is there something particularly magical to you about the whole developmental biology

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: process?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Is there something you could say?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You just said it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They're very good at accomplishing the goal, the job they need to do, the competency thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: but you get freaking organism for one cell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's very hard to intuit that whole process, to even think about reverse engineering that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I did it very hard to the point where I often...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Just imagine, I sometimes ask my students to do this thought experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Imagine you were shrunk down to the scale of a single cell, and you were in the middle

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of an embryo, and you were looking around at what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The cells running around, some cells are dying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Every time you look, it's kind of a different number of cells for most organisms and so

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that if you didn't know what embryonic development was, you would have no clue that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: what you're seeing is always going to make the same thing, never mind knowing what that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Even with full genomic information, being able to say, what the hell are they building?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We have no way to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Just even to guess that, wow, the outcome of all this activity, it's always going to

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: build the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The imperative to create the final you, as you are now, is there already.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You start from the same embryo, you create a very similar organism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, except for cases like the xenobots, when you give them a different environment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: they come up with a different way to be adaptive in that environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Overall, I think to summarize it, I think what evolution is really good at is creating

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: hardware that has a very stable baseline mode, meaning that left to its own devices, it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: very good at doing the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But it has a bunch of problem solving capacity such that if any assumptions don't hold,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: if your cells are a weird size or you get the wrong number of cells or there's somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: stuck in electrode halfway through the body, whatever, it will still get most of what it

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: needs to do done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You've talked about the magic and the power of biology here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If we look at the human brain, how special is the brain in this context?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You're minimizing the importance of the brain or lessening its... We think of all the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: special computation happens in the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Everything else is like the help.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You're saying that the whole thing is doing computation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But nevertheless, how special is the human brain in this full context of biology?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, look, there's no getting away from the fact that the human brain allows us to

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: do things that we could not do without it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can say the same thing about the liver.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: In the heart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This is true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: My goal is not... No, you're right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: My goal is not... You're just being polite to the brain right

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Well, look... You're being a politician.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Listen, everybody has a use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Everybody has a role.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's a very important role.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We have to acknowledge the importance of the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There are more than enough people who are cheerleading the brain, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I don't feel like nothing I say is going to reduce people's excitement about the human

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I emphasize other things... Do you think it gets too much credit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't think it gets too much credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think other things don't get enough credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think the human brain is incredible and special and all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think other things need more credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And I also think that... And I'm sort of this way about everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't like binary categories about almost anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I like a continuum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And the thing about the human brain is that by accepting that as some kind of an important

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: category or essential thing, we end up with all kinds of weird pseudo problems and conundrums.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So for example, when we talk about it, if you want to talk about ethics and other things

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: like that, and this idea that surely if we look out into the universe, surely we don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: believe that this human brain is the only way to be sentient, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Surely we don't... And to have high level cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I can't even wrap my mind around this idea that that is the only way to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: No doubt there are other architectures made of completely different principles that achieve

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And once we believe that, then that tells us something important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It tells us that things that are not quite human brains or chimeras of human brains and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: other tissue or human brains or other kinds of brains and novel configurations or things

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that are sort of brains but not really or plants or embryos or whatever might also have

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: important cognitive status.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So that's the only thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think we have to be really careful about treating the human brain as if it was some

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: kind of like sharp binary category, you are or you aren't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't believe that exists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So when we look out at all the beautiful variety of semi-biological architectures out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: in the universe, how many intelligent alien civilizations do you think are out there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Boy, I have no expertise in that whatsoever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You haven't met any?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I have met the ones we've made.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that... Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: In some sense, with synthetic biology, are you not creating aliens?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I absolutely think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Because look, all standard model systems are an N of one course of evolution on Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And trying to make conclusions about biology from looking at life on Earth is like testing

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: your theory on the same data that generated it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's all kind of like locked in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So we absolutely have to create novel examples that have no history on Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The xenobots have no history of selection to be a good xenobot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The cells have selection for various things, but the xenobot itself never existed before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so we can make chimeras, we make frog a lot of those that are sort of half frog,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: half axolotl.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can make all sorts of high brats, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Constructions of living tissue with robots and whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We need to be making these things until we find actual aliens because otherwise we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: just looking at an N of one set of examples, all kinds of frozen accidents of evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We need to go beyond that to really understand biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But we're still, even when you're doing synthetic biology, you're locked in to the basic components

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of the way biology is done on this Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Still limited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And also the basic constraints of the environment, even artificial environments that are constructed

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: in the lab are tied up to the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, what do you...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Okay, let's say there is, I mean, what I think is there's a nearly infinite number of intelligent

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: civilizations living or dead out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you pick one out of the box, what do you think it would look like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So when you think about synthetic biology or creating synthetic organisms, how hard

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: is it to create something that's very different?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, I think it's very hard to create something that's very different, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We are just locked in both experimentally and in terms of our imagination, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's very hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And you also emphasize several times the idea of shape.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The individual cell get together with other cells and they're going to build a shape.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So it's shape and function, but shape is a critical thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So here I'll take a stab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, I agree with you to whatever extent that we can say anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I do think that there's probably an infinite number of different architectures that are

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: with interest in cognitive properties out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What can we say about them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that the only things that are going...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't think we can rely on any of the typical stuff, carbon-based, none of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think all of that is just us having a lack of imagination.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But I think the things that are going to be universal, if anything is, are things, for

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: example, driven by resource limitation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The fact that you are fighting a hostile world and you have to draw a boundary between yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and the world somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The fact that that boundary is not given to you by anybody, you have to assume it, estimate

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: it yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And the fact that you have to coarse grain your experience and the fact that you're going

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to try to minimize surprise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: These are the things that I think are fundamental about biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: None of the facts about the genetic code or even the fact that we have genes or the biochemistry

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't think any of those things are fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But it's going to be a lot more about the information and about the creation of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: self.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The fact that...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So in my framework, selves are demarcated by the scale of the goals that they can pursue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So from little tiny local goals to massive planetary scale goals for certain humans and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: everything in between.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So you can draw this cognitive light cone that determines the scale of the goals you could

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: possibly pursue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think those kinds of frameworks like that, like active inference and so on, are going

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to be universally applicable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But none of the other things that are typically discussed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Quick pause.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Dean of Bath & Break?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We were just talking about aliens and all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's a funny thing, which is...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know if you've seen them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's a debate that goes on about cognition and plants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What can you say about different kinds of computation and cognition and plants?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And I always look at that stuff and I'm like, if you're weirded out by cognition and plants,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: you're not ready for exobiology, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If something that's that similar here on earth is already freaking you out, then I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: there's going to be all kinds of cognitive life out there that we're going to have a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: really hard time recognizing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think robots will help us expand our mind about cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Either that or the work like xenobots and they maybe becomes the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: When the human engineers the thing, at least in part, and then is able to achieve some

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: kind of cognition that's different than what you're used to, then you start to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: like, oh, every living organism is capable of cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I need to broaden my understanding what cognition is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But do you think plants, when you eat them, are they screaming?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know about screaming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think you have to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's what I think when I eat a salad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think you have to scale down the expectations in terms of...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So probably they're not screaming in the way that we would be screaming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: However, there's plenty of data on plants being able to do anticipation and certain

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: kinds of memory and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think what you just said about robots, I hope you're right and I hope that's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But there's two ways that people can take that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: One way is exactly what you just said to try to expand their notions for that category.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The other way people often go is they just define the term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If it's not a natural product, it's just faking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's not really intelligence if it was made by somebody else because it's the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They can see how it's done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Once you see how it's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's like a magic trick when you see how it's done, it's not as fun anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think people have a real tendency for that and they sort of...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Which I find really strange in the sense that if somebody said to me, we have this sort

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of blind hill climbing search and then we have a really smart team of engineers, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: one do you think is going to produce a system that has good intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think it's really weird to say that it only comes from the blind search.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It can't be done by people who, by the way, can also use evolutionary techniques if they

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: want to, but also rational design.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think it's really weird to say that real intelligence only comes from natural evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I hope you're right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I hope people take it the other way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's a nice shortcut.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I work with legged robots a lot now for my own personal pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Not in that way, internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So four legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And one of the things that changes my experience with the robots a lot is when I can't understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: why I did a certain thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And there's a lot of ways to engineer that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Me, the person that created the software that runs it, there's a lot of ways for me to build

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that software in such a way that I don't exactly know why it did a certain basic decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Of course, as an engineer, you can go in and start to look at logs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can log all kinds of data, sensory data, the decisions you made, all the outputs in

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: your networks and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But I also try to really experience that surprise and that really experience as another person

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: would that totally doesn't know how it's built.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And I think the magic is there and not knowing how it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think biology does that for you through the layers of abstraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Because nobody really knows what's going on inside the biological.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Each one component is clueless about the big picture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think there's actually really cheap systems that can illustrate that kind of thing, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: is even fractals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You have a very small, short formula in Z and you see it and there's no magic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You're just going to crank through Z squared plus C, whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You're just going to crank through it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But the result of it is this incredibly rich, beautiful image that just like, wow, all of

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that was in this 10-character long string.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The fact that you can know everything there is to know about the details and the process

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and all the parts and everything, there's literally no magic of any kind there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And yet the outcome is something that you would never have expected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It just is incredibly rich and complex and beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's a lot of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You write that you work on developing conceptual frameworks for understanding unconventional

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The kind of thing we've been talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I just like the term unconventional cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You want to figure out how to detect, study, and communicate with a thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You've already mentioned a few examples, but what is unconventional cognition?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Is it as simply as everything outside of what we define usually as cognition, cognitive

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: science, the stuff going on between our ears?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Or is there some deeper way to get at the fundamentals of what is cognition?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, I think like, and I'm certainly not the only person who works in unconventional

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So, it's the term used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, that's one that I saw.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I've coined a number of weird terms, but that's not one of mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's an existing thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So, for example, somebody like Andy Adamatsky, who I don't know if you've had him on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you haven't, you should.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: He's a very interesting guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: He's a computer scientist and he does unconventional cognition and slime molds and all kinds of

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: weird.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: He's a real weird cat, really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Anyway, so that's a bunch of terms that I've come up with, but that's not one of mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I think like many terms, that one is really defined by the times, meaning that things

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that are unconventional cognition today are not going to be considered unconventional

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: cognition at some point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's one of those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so, it's this really deep question of how do you recognize, communicate with, classify

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: cognition when you cannot rely on the typical milestones?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So typical, again, if you stick with the history of life on earth, like these exact model systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: you would say, ah, here's a particular structure of the brain and this one has fewer of those

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and this one has a bigger frontal cortex and this one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So these are landmarks that we're used to and it allows us to make very kind of rapid

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: judgments about things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But if you can't rely on that, either because you're looking at a synthetic thing or an

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: engineered thing or an alien thing, then what do you do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: How do you...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so that's what I'm really interested in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I'm interested in mind in all of its possible implementations, not just the obvious ones

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that we know from looking at brains here on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Whenever I think about something like unconventional cognition, I think about cellular automata.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I'm just captivated by the beauty of the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The fact that from simple little objects, you can create some such beautiful complexity

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that very quickly you forget about the individual objects and you see the things that it creates

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: as its own organisms, that blows my mind every time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Like honestly, I could full time just eat mushrooms and watch cellular automata.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Don't even have to do mushrooms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Just cellular automata.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It feels like, I mean, from the engineer perspective, I love when a very simple system captures

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: something really powerful because then you can study that system to understand something

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: fundamental about complexity, about life on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Anyway, how do I communicate with a thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Cellular automata can do cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If a plant can do cognition, if a xenobot can do cognition, how do I like whisper in

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: its ear and get an answer back to, how do I have a conversation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Well...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: How do I have a xenobot on a podcast?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's a really interesting line of investigation that opens up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We thought about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You need a few things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You need to understand the space in which they live.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Not just the physical modality, like can they see light?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Can they feel vibration?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, that's important, of course, because that's how you deliver your message.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But not just the ideas for a communication medium, not just the physical medium, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: saliency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So what are important to this system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And systems have all kinds of different levels of sophistication of what you could expect

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to get back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And I think what's really important, I call this the spectrum of persuadability, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: is this idea that when you're looking at a system, you can't assume where on the spectrum

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You have to do experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so, for example, if you look at a gene regulatory network, which is just a bunch

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of nodes that turn each other on and off at various rates, you might look at that and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: say, well, there's no magic here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, clearly this thing is as deterministic as it gets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's a piece of hardware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The only way we're going to be able to control it is by rewiring it, which is the way molecular

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: biology works, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We can add nodes, remove nodes, whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Well, so we've done simulations and shown that biological, and now we're doing this

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: in the lab, the biological networks like that have associative memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So they can actually learn from experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They have habituation, they have sensitization, they have associative memory, which you wouldn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: have known if you assume that they have to be on the left side of that spectrum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So when you're going to communicate with something, and Charles Abramson and I have

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: written a paper on behaviorist approaches to synthetic organisms, meaning that if you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: given something, you have no idea what it is or what it can do, how do you figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: what its psychology is, what its level is, what does it...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so we literally lay out a set of protocols, starting with the simplest things and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325
