body.input: And so that can be, it's not just on earth because it can be done in the computer, it

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: can be done in chemical systems, it can be done in, you know, Lee Smolin says it works

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: in on cosmic scales.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I think that that kind of thing is incredibly pervasive and general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's a general feature of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's interesting to think about, you know, the standard thought about this is that it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: blind, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Meaning that the intelligence of the process is zero, it's stumbling around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And I think that back in the day when the options were it's dumb like machines or it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: smart like humans, then of course the scientists went in this direction because nobody wanted

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: creationism and said, okay, it's got to be like completely blind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I'm not actually sure, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Because I think that everything is a continuum and I think that it doesn't have to be smart

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: with foresight like us, but it doesn't have to be completely blind either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think there may be aspects of it and in particular this kind of multi-scale competency

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: might give it a little bit of look ahead maybe or a little bit of problem solving sort of

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: baked in, but that's going to be completely different in different systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But I do think it's general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't think it's just on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think it's a very fundamental thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It does seem to have a kind of direction that is taking us that's somehow perhaps is defined

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: by the environment itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It feels like we're headed towards something like we're playing out a script that was just

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: like a single cell defines the entire organism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It feels like from the origin of earth itself, it's playing out a kind of script.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can't really go any other way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, so this is very controversial and I don't know the answer, but people have argued

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that this is called sort of rewinding the tape of life, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And some people have argued, I think Conway Morris maybe has argued that there's a deep

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: attractor for example to the human kind of structure and that if you were to rewind it

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: again you'd basically get more or less the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And another people have argued that no, it's incredibly sensitive to frozen accidents and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that once certain stochastic decisions are made downstream everything is going to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We're very bad at predicting attractors in the space of complex systems generally speaking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So maybe evolution on earth has these deep attractors that no matter what has happened

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: pretty much would likely to end up there or maybe not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Well, it's a really difficult idea to imagine that if you ran earth a million times, 500,000

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: times you would get Hitler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We don't like to think like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We think like, because at least maybe in America you like to think that individual decisions

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: can change the world and if individual decisions could change the world then surely any perturbation

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: results in a totally different trajectory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Maybe there's in this competency hierarchy, it's a self-correcting system that just ultimately

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: there's a bunch of chaos that ultimately is leading towards something like a super intelligent

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: artificial intelligence system that answers 42.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, there might be a kind of imperative for life that it's headed to and we're too

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: focused on our day-to-day life of getting coffee and snacks and having sex and getting

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: a promotion at work not to see the big imperative of life on earth that is headed towards something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, maybe, maybe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think one of the things that's important about Chimerica, bioengineering technologies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: all of those things are that we have to start developing a better science of predicting

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the cognitive goals of composite systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We're just not very good at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We don't know if I create a composite system and this could be Internet of Things or swarm

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: robotics or cellular swarm or whatever, what is the emergent intelligence of this thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: First of all, what level is it going to be at and if it has goal-directed capacity, what

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: are the goals going to be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We are just not very good at predicting that yet and I think that it's an existential level

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: need for us to be able to because we're building these things all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We're building both physical structures like swarm robotics and we're building social financial

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: structures and so on with very little ability to predict what sort of autonomous goals that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: system is going to have, of which we are now cogs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Learning to predict and control those things is going to be critical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you're right and there is some kind of a tractor to evolution, it would be nice to

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: know what that is and then to make a rational decision of whether we're going to go along

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: or we're going to pop out of it or try to pop out of it because there's no guarantee.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's the other important thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: A lot of people, I get a lot of complaints from people who email me and say, what you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: doing, it isn't natural.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I'll say, look, natural, that'd be nice if somebody was making sure that natural was

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: matched up to our values, but no one's doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Evolution optimizes for biomass.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Nobody's optimizing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's not optimizing for your happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's not necessarily optimizing for intelligence or fairness or any of that stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I'm going to find that person that emailed you, beat them up, take their place, steal

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: everything they own and say, now this is natural.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This is natural.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Because it comes from an old worldview where you could assume that whatever is natural,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that that's probably for the best.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think we're long out of that garden of Eden kind of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think we can do better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think we have to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Natural just isn't great for a lot of life forms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What are some cool synthetic organisms that you think about, you dream about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: When you think about embodied mind, what do you imagine?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What do you hope to build?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, on a practical level, what I really hope to do is to gain enough of an understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of the embodied intelligence of the organs and tissues such that we can achieve a radically

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: different regenerative medicine so that we can say, basically, and I think about it in

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: terms of like, okay, what's the goal kind of end game for this whole thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: To me, the end game is something that you would call an anatomical compiler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The idea is you would sit down in front of the computer and you would draw the body or

body.input: the organ that you wanted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Not molecular details, but like, yeah, this is what I want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I want a six-legged frog with a propeller on top, or I want a heart that looks like

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: this, or I want a leg that looks like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What it would do if we knew what we were doing is convert that anatomical description into

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: a set of stimuli that would have to be given to cells to convince them to build exactly

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I probably won't live to see it, but I think it's achievable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think if we can have that, then that is basically the solution to all of medicine

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: except for infectious disease.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Birth defects, traumatic injury, cancer, aging, degenerative disease.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If we knew how to tell cells what to build, all of those things go away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Those things go away and the positive feedback spiral of economic costs where all of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: advances are increasingly more heroic and expensive interventions of a sinking ship

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: when you're like 90 and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: All of that goes away because basically instead of trying to fix you up as you degrade, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: progressively regenerate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You apply the regenerative medicine early before things degrade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that will have massive economic impacts over what we're trying to do now, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: not at all sustainable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's what I hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I hope that we get it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: To me, yes, the xenobots will be doing useful things, cleaning up the environment, cleaning

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: out your joints and all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: More important than that, I think we can use these synthetic systems to try to understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to develop a science of detecting and manipulating the goals of collective intelligences of cells,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: specifically for regenerative medicine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Then beyond that, if we think further beyond that, what I hope is that like what you said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: all of this drives a reconsideration of how we formulate ethical norms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This old school...

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: In the olden days, what you could do is you were confronted with something new.

body.input: You could tap on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you heard a metallic clanging sound, you'd said, fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You could conclude it was made in a factory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I can take it apart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I can do whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you did that and you got a squishy warm sensation, you'd say, I need to be more or
