body.input: less nice to it and whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's not going to be feasible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It was never really feasible, but it was good enough because we didn't know any better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That needs to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that by breaking down those artificial barriers, someday we can try to build a system

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of ethical norms that does not rely on these completely contingent facts of our earthly

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: history, but on something much, much deeper that really takes agency and the capacity

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to suffer and all that takes that seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The capacity to suffer and the deep questions I would ask of a system is can they eat it

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and can I have sex with it, which is the two fundamental tests of, again, the human condition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I can basically do what Dolly does in the physical space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Print out a 3D print Pepe the Frog with a propeller hat is the dream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Well, yes and no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I want to get away from the 3D printing thing because that will be available for some things

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: much earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We can already do bladders and ears and things like that because it's micro level control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: When you 3D print, you are in charge of where every cell goes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: For some things, for like this thing, they had that I think 20 years ago or maybe earlier

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: than that, you could do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I would like to emphasize the Dolly part where you provide a few words and it generates a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: painting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There you say, I want a frog with these features and then it would go direct a complex biological

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: system to construct something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The main magic would be, I mean, I think from looking at Dolly and so on, it looks like

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the first part is kind of solved now where you go from the words to the image.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That seems more or less solved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The next step is really hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This is what keeps things like CRISPR and genomic editing and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This is what limits all the impacts for regenerative medicine because going back to, okay, this

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: is the knee joint that I want or this is the eye that I want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Now what genes do I edit to make that happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Going back in that direction is really hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Instead of that, it's going to be, okay, I understand how to motivate cells to build

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: particular structures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Can I rewrite the memory of what they think they're supposed to be building such that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: then I can take my hands off the wheel and let them do their thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Some of that is experiment, but some of that maybe AI can help too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Just like with protein folding, this is exactly the problem that protein folding in the most

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: simple medium tried and has solved with alpha fold, which is how does the sequence of letters

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: result in this three-dimensional shape?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I guess it didn't solve it because if you say, I want this shape, how do I then have

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: a sequence of letters?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, the reverse engineering step is really tricky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think we're doing some of this now is to use AI to try and build actionable models

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of the intelligence of the cellular collectives, to try to help us gain models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We've had some success in this, so we did something like this for repairing birth defects

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of the brain in frog.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We've done some of this for normalizing melanoma where you can really start to use AI to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: models of how would I impact this thing if I wanted to given all the complexities and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: given all the controls that it knows how to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So when you say regenerative medicine, so we talked about creating biological organisms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: but if you regrow a hand, that information is already there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The biological system has that information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So how does regenerative medicine work today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: How do you hope it works?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What's the hope there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: How do you make it happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Well today there's a set of popular approaches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So one is 3D printing, so the idea is I'm going to make a scaffold of the thing that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I want, I'm going to seed it with cells, and then there it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So kind of direct, and then that works for certain things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can make a bladder that way or an ear, something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The other idea is some sort of stem cell transplant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: These are the ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If we put in stem cells with appropriate factors, we can get them to generate certain kinds

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of neurons for certain diseases and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: All of those things are good for relatively simple structures, but when you want an eye

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: or a hand or something else, I think in this maybe an unpopular opinion, I think the only

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: hope we have in any reasonable kind of timeframe is to understand how the thing was motivated

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to get made in the first place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So what is it that made those cells in the beginning create a particular arm with a particular

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: set of sizes and shapes and number of fingers and all that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And why is it that a salamander can keep losing theirs and keep regrowing theirs and a planarian

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: can do the same?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Even more so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: To me, kind of ultimate regenerative medicine was when you can tell the cells to build whatever

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: it is you need them to build, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so that we can all be like planaria, basically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Do you have to start at the very beginning or can you do a shortcut?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Because if you're growing a hand, you already got the whole organism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So here's what we've done, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So we've more or less solved that in frogs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So frogs, unlike salamanders, do not regenerate their legs as adults.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so we've shown that with a very kind of simple intervention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So what we do is there's two things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You need to have a signal that tells the cells what to do and then you need some way of delivering

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so this is work together with David Kaplan and I should do a disclosure here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We have a company called MorphoCeuticals and it's a spinoff where we're trying to address

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: a limb regeneration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So we've solved it in the frog and we're now in trials in mice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So now we're going to go over in mammals now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I can't say anything about how it's going, but the frog thing is solved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So what you do is after-

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So you can have a little frog-loose Skywalker with every growing hand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, basically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So what you do is we did with legs instead of forearms and what you do is after amputation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: normally they don't regenerate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You put on a wearable bioreactor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So it's this thing that goes on and Dave Kaplan's lab makes these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And inside it's a very controlled environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It is a silk gel that carries some drugs, for example, ion channel drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And what you're doing is you're saying to these cells, you should regrow what normally

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: goes here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So that whole thing is on for 24 hours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Then you take it off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You don't touch the leg again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This is really important because what we're not looking for is a set of micromanagement,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: printing or controlling the cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We want to trigger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We want to interact with it early on and then not touch it again because we don't know how

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to make a frog leg.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The frog knows how to make a frog leg.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So 24 hours, 18 months of leg growth after that without us touching it again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And after 18 months, you get a pretty good leg.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That kind of shows this proof of concept that early on when the cells, right after injury,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: when they're first making a decision about what they're going to do, you can impact them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And once they've decided to make a leg, they don't need you after that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They can do their own thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So that's an approach that we're now taking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What about cancer suppression?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's something you mentioned earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: How can all of these ideas help with cancer suppression?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So let's go back to the beginning and ask what cancer is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I think asking why there's cancer is the wrong question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think the right question is why is there ever anything but cancer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So in the normal state, you have a bunch of cells that are all cooperating towards a large

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: scale goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If that process of cooperation breaks down and you've got a cell that is isolated from

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that electrical network that lets you remember what the big goal is, you revert back to your

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: unicellular lifestyle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: As far as, now think about that border between self and world, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Normally when all these cells are connected by gap junctions into an electrical network,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: they are all one self, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Meaning that they have these large tissue level goals and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: As soon as a cell is disconnected from that, the self is tiny, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so at that point, and so a lot of people model cancer cells as being more selfish

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They're not more selfish.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They're equally selfish.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's just that their self is smaller.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Normally the self is huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Now they got tiny little selves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Now, what are the goals of tiny little selves?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Well, proliferate and migrate to wherever life is good and that's metastasis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's proliferation and metastasis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So one thing we found and people have noticed years ago that when cells convert to cancer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the first thing they see is they close the gap junctions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And it's a lot like, I think it's a lot like that experiment with the slime mold where

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: until you close that gap junction, you can't even entertain the idea of leaving the collective

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: because there is no you at that point, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Your mind melded with this whole other network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But as soon as the gap junction is closed, now the boundary between you and now the rest

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of the body is just outside environment to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You're just a unicellular organism in the rest of the body's environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So we studied this process and we worked out a way to artificially control the bioelectric

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: state of these cells to physically force them to remain in that network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so then what that means is that nasty mutations like KRAS and things like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: these really tough oncogenic mutations that cause tumors, if you do them and then – but

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: then artificially control the bioelectrics, you greatly reduce tumor genesis or normalize

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: cells that had already begun to convert you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Basically they go back to being normal cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so this is another – much like with the planaria, this is another way in which

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the bioelectric state kind of dominates what the genetic state is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So if you sequence the nucleic acids, you'll see the KRAS mutation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You'll say, well, that's going to be a tumor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But there isn't a tumor because bioelectrically you've kept the cells connected and they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: just working on making nice skin and kidneys and whatever else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So we've started moving that to human glioblastoma cells and we're hoping for a patient in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: future interaction with patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So is this one of the possible ways in which we may quote cure cancer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think the actual cure – I mean, there are other technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Immune therapy I think is a great technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Chemotherapy I don't think is a good technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think we've got to get off of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So chemotherapy just kills cells?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Well, chemotherapy hopes to kill more of the tumor cells than of your cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The problem is the cells are very similar because they are your cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so if you don't have a very tight way of distinguishing between them, then the toll

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that chemo takes on the rest of the body is just unbelievable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Immune therapy tries to get the immune system to do some of the work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that's potentially a very good approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If the immune system can be taught to recognize enough of the cancer cells, that's a pretty

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: good approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But I think our approach is in a way more fundamental because if you can keep the cells

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: harnessed towards organ level goals as opposed to individual cell goals, then nobody will

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: be making a tumor or metastasizing and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So we've been living through a pandemic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What do you think about viruses in this full, beautiful biological context we've been talking

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Are they beautiful to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Are they terrifying?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Also maybe, let's say, since we've been discriminating this whole conversation, are they living?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Are they embodied minds?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Embodied minds that are assholes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: As far as I know, and I haven't been able to find this paper again, but somewhere I

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: saw in the last couple of months, there was some paper showing an example of a virus that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: actually had physiology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So something was going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think proton flux or something on the virus itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But barring that, generally speaking, viruses are very passive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They don't do anything by themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so I don't see any particular reason to attribute much of a mind to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think they represent a way to hijack other minds for sure, like cells and other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But that's an interesting interplay though.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If they're hijacking other minds, the way we were talking about living organisms that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: they can interact with each other and alter each other's trajectory by having interacted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's a deep, meaningful connection between a virus and a cell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think both are transformed by the experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So in that sense, both are living.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The whole category, this question of what's living and what's not living, I'm not sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And I know there's people that work on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't want to piss anybody off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But I have not found that particularly useful as to try and make that a binary distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think level of cognition is very interesting as a continuum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But living and non-living, I really know what to do with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know what you do next after making that distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's why I make the very binary distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Can I have sex with it or not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Can I eat it or not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Because those are actionable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that's a critical point that you brought up because how you relate to something is

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: really what this is all about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: As an engineer, how do I control it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But maybe I shouldn't be controlling it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Maybe I should be, can I have a relationship with it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Should I be listening to its advice?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: All the way from, I need to take it apart, all the way to, I better do what it says because

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: it seems to be pretty smart and everything in between.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's really what we're asking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We need to understand our relationship to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We're searching for that relationship, even in the most trivial senses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You came up with a lot of interesting terms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We've mentioned some of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: A gential material, that's a really interesting one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: For the future of computation and artificial intelligence and computer science and all

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's also, let me go through some of them, if they spark some interesting thought for

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's teleophobia, the unwarranted fear of erring on the side of too much agency when

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: considering a new system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's the opposite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, being afraid of maybe anthropomorphizing the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: This will get some people ticked off, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But I don't think, I think the whole notion of anthropomorphizing is a holdover from a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: pre-scientific age where humans were magic and everything else wasn't magic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And you were anthropomorphizing when you dared suggest that something else has some features

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think we need to be way beyond that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And this issue of anthropomorphizing, I think it's a cheap charge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't think it holds any water at all other than when somebody makes a cognitive claim.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think all cognitive claims are engineering claims, really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So when somebody says this thing knows or this thing hopes or this thing wants or this

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: thing predicts, all you can say is fabulous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Give me the engineering protocol that you've derived using that hypothesis and we will

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: see if this thing helps us or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And then we can make a rational decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I also like anatomical compiler, a future system representing the long-term end game

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of the science of morphogenesis that reminds us how far away from true understanding we

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Someday, you will be able to sit in front of an anatomical computer, specify the shape

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of the animal or plant that you want, and it will convert that shape specification to

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: a set of stimuli that will have to be given to cells to build exactly that shape.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: No matter how weird it ends up being, you have total control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Just imagine the possibility for memes in the physical space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: One of the glorious accomplishments of human civilizations is memes in digital space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Now, this could create memes in physical space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I am both excited and terrified by that possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Of light cone, I think we also talked about the outer boundary in space and time of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: largest goal a given system can work towards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Is this kind of like shaping the set of options?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's a little different than options.

body.input: It's really focused on...

body.input: Back in 2018, I want to say, there was a Templeton conference where they challenged us to come

body.input: up with frameworks.

body.input: Yeah, they had a summer institute.

body.input: That's the logo.

body.input: It's the bee with some circuits.

body.input: Yeah, it's got different life forms.
