metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: a plant and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I started thinking about this and I asked myself, what do all cognitive agents, no matter

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: what their provenance, no matter what their architecture is, what do cognitive agents

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: have in common?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It seems to me that what they have in common is some degree of competency to pursue a goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What you can do then is you can draw.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What I ended up drawing was this thing that it's kind of like a backwards Minkowski cone

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: diagram where all of space is collapsed into one axis and then here and then time is this

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: axis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Then what you can do is you can draw for any creature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can semi-quantitatively estimate what are the spatial and temporal goals that it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: capable of pursuing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: For example, if you are a tick and all you really are able to pursue is a bacteria maximizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the level of some chemical in your vicinity, that's all you've got, it's a tiny little

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: like cone, then you're a simple system like a tick or a bacteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you are something like a dog, well, you've got some ability to care about some spatial

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: region, some temporal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can remember a little bit backwards, you can predict a little bit forwards, but you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: never ever going to care about what happens in the next town over four weeks from now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: As far as we know, it's just impossible for that kind of architecture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you're a human, you might be working towards world peace long after your death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You might have a planetary scale goal that's enormous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Then there may be other greater intelligences somewhere that can care in the linear range

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: about numbers of creatures that some sort of Buddha-like character that can care about

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: everybody's welfare, really care the way that we can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's not a mapping of what you can sense, how far you can sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's not a mapping of how far you can act.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's a mapping of how big are the goals you are capable of envisioning and working towards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that enables you to put synthetic kinds of constructs, AIs, aliens, swarms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: whatever on the same diagram because we're not talking about what you're made of or how

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: you got here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We're talking about what are the size and complexity of the goals towards which you

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: can work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Is there any other terms that pop into mind that are interesting?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Trying to remember.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I have a list of them somewhere on my website.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Target morphology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, definitely check it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Morphosutical, I like that one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Ionosutical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, those refer to different types of interventions in the regenerative medicine

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So, a morphosutical is something that it's a kind of intervention that really targets

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the cell's decision-making process about what they're going to build.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And ionosuticals are like that but more focused specifically on the bioelectrics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, there's also of course biochemical, biomechanical, who knows what else, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: maybe optical kinds of signaling systems there as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Target morphology is interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's designed to capture this idea that it's not just feed-forward emergence and oftentimes

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: in biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I know that happens too, but in many cases in biology, the system is specifically working

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: towards a target in anatomical morphospace, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's a navigation task really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: These kind of problem-solving can be, you know, formalized as navigation tasks and that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: they're really going towards a particular region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: How do you know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Because you deviate them and then they go back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Let me ask you because you've really challenged a lot of ideas in biology in the work you

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: do probably because some of your rebelliousness comes from the fact that you came from a different

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: field of computer engineering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But could you give advice to young people today in high school or college that are trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to pave their life story, whether it's in science or elsewhere, how they can have a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: career they can be proud of or a life they can be proud of?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Advice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Boy, it's dangerous to give advice because things change so fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But one central thing I can say, moving up and through academia and whatnot, you will

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: be surrounded by really smart people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And what you need to do is be very careful at distinguishing specific critique versus

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: kind of meta-advice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What I mean by that is if somebody really smart and successful and obviously competent

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: is giving you specific critiques on what you've done, that's gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's an opportunity to hone your craft to get better at what you're doing, to learn,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to find your mistakes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If they are telling you what you ought to be studying, how you ought to approach things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: what is the right way to think about things, you should probably ignore most of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And the reason I make that distinction is that a lot of really successful people are

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: very well calibrated on their own ideas and their own field and their own sort of area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And they know exactly what works and what doesn't and what's good and what's bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But they're not calibrated on your ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so the things they will say, oh, this is a dumb idea, don't do this and you shouldn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: do that, that stuff is generally worse than useless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It can be very demoralizing and really limiting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so what I say to people is read very broadly, work really hard, know what you're talking

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: about, take all specific criticism as an opportunity to improve what you're doing and then completely

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: ignore everything else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Because I just tell you from my own experience, most of what I consider to be interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and useful things that we've done, very smart people have said this is a terrible idea,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: don't do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think we just don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We have no idea beyond our own, like at best we know what we ought to be doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We very rarely know what anybody else should be doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And their ideas, their perspective has been also calibrated not just on their field and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: specific situation, but also on a state of that field at a particular time in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So there's not many people in this world that are able to achieve revolutionary success

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: multiple times in their life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So whenever you say somebody very smart, usually what that means is somebody who's smart, who

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: achieved a success at certain point in their life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And people often get stuck in that place where they found success to be constantly challenging

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: your worldview is a very difficult thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And also at the same time, probably if a lot of people tell, that's the weird thing about

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If a lot of people tell you that something is stupid or is not going to work, that either

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: means it's stupid, it's not going to work, or it's actually a great opportunity to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: something new.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And you don't know which one it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's probably equally likely to be either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If not, well, I don't know the probabilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Depends how lucky you are, depends how brilliant you are, but you don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so you can't take that advice as actual data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You have to, and this is kind of hard and fuzzy, hard to describe and fuzzy, but I'm

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: a firm believer that you have to build up your own intuition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So over time, you have to take your own risks that seem like they make sense to you and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: then learn from that and build up so that you can trust your own gut about what's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: good idea even when, and then sometimes you'll make mistakes and it'll turn out to be a dead

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: end and that's fine, that's science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But what I tell my students is life is hard and science is hard and you're going to sweat

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and bleed and everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And you should be doing that for ideas that really fire you up inside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And really don't let kind of the common denominator of standardized approaches to things slow

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: you down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So you mentioned planaria being in some sense immortal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What's the role of death in life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What's the role of death in this whole process we have?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Is it, when you look at biological systems, is death an important feature, especially

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: as you climb up the hierarchy of competency?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Boy, that's an interesting question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think that it's certainly a factor that promotes change and turnover and an opportunity

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to do something different the next time for a larger scale system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So apoptosis, it's really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Death is really interesting in a number of ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: One is you could think about what was the first thing to die?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's an interesting question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What was the first creature that you could say actually died?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's a tough thing because we don't have a great definition for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So if you bring a cabbage home and you put it in your fridge, at what point are you going

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to say it's died?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So it's kind of hard to know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's one paper in which I talk about this idea that – I mean think about this and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: imagine that you have a creature that's aquatic, let's say it's a frog or something

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: or a tadpole and the animal dies in the pond, it dies for whatever reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Most of the cells are still alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So you could imagine that if when it died there was some sort of breakdown of the connectivity

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: between the cells, a bunch of cells crawled off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They could have a life as amoebas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Some of them could join together and become a xenobot and tootle around, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So we know from planaria that there are cells that don't obey the Hayflick limit and just

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: sort of live forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So you could imagine an organism that when the organism dies, it doesn't disappear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Rather the individual cells that are still alive crawl off and have a completely different

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: kind of lifestyle and maybe come back together as something else or maybe they don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So all of this I'm sure is happening somewhere on some planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So death in any case – I mean we already kind of knew this because the molecules – we

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: know that when something dies the molecules go through the ecosystem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But even the cells don't necessarily die at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: They might have another life in a different way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can think about something like Gila, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The Gila cell line that's had this incredible life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There are way more Gila cells now than there ever been – than there were when she was

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So it feels like as the organisms become more and more complex, like if you look at the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: mammals, their relationship with death becomes more and more complex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So the survival imperative starts becoming interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And humans are arguably the first species that have invented the fear of death, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: understanding that you're going to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Let's put it this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Not like instinctual like I need to run away from the thing that's going to eat me, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: starting to contemplate the finiteness of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean one thing – so one thing about the human cognitive light cone is that for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: first – as far as we know, for the first time you might have goals that are longer

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: than your lifespan – that are not achievable, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So if you are – let's say – and I don't know if this is true, but if you're a goldfish

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and you have a 10-minute attention span, I'm not sure if that's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Let's say there's some organism with a short kind of cognitive light cone that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: All of your goals are potentially achievable because you're probably going to live the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: next 10 minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So whatever goals you have, they are totally achievable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you're a human, you could have all kinds of goals that are guaranteed not achievable

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: because they just take too long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Like guaranteed you're not going to achieve them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I wonder if – is that a perennial sort of thorn in our psychology that drives some

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: psychoses or whatever?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I have no idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Another interesting thing about that actually – I've been thinking about this a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: in the last couple of weeks – this notion of giving up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So you would think that evolutionarily the most adaptive way of being is that you go

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: – you fight as long as you physically can and then when you can't, you can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And there's this photograph – there's videos you can find of insects crawling around

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: where most of it is already gone and it's still sort of crawling like Terminator style,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Like as far as – as long as you physically can, you keep going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Mammals don't do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So a lot of mammals, including rats, have this thing where when they think it's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: hopeless situation, they literally give up and die when physically they could have kept

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean humans certainly do this and there's some really unpleasant experiments that this

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: guy – I forget his name – did with drowning rats where rats normally drown after a couple

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But if you teach them that if you just tread water for a couple of minutes, you'll get

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: rescued, they can tread water for like an hour.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so they literally just give up and die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And so evolutionarily that doesn't seem like a good strategy at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Evolutionarily it seems like why would you – like what's the benefit ever of giving

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: up?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You just do what you can and one time out of a thousand, you'll actually get rescued,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And the issue of actually giving up suggests some very interesting metacognitive controls

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: where you've now gotten to the point where survival actually isn't the top drive and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that for whatever – there are other considerations that have taken over and I think that's uniquely

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: a mammalian thing, but I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, the Camus, the existentialist question of why live, just the fact that humans commit

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: suicide is a really fascinating question from an evolutionary perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: And what was the first – and that's the other thing, what is the simplest system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: whether evolved or natural or whatever, that is able to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You can think what other animals are actually able to do that, I'm not sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Maybe you could see animals over time for some reason lowering the value of survive

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: at all costs gradually until other objectives might become more important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Maybe I don't know how evolutionarily how that gets off the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That just seems like that would have such a strong pressure against it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Just imagine a population with a lower – if you were a mutant in a population that had

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: less of a survival imperative, would your genes outperform the others?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It seems not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think the first thing is population selection because maybe suicide is a way for organisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to decide themselves that they're not fit for the environment somehow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah, that's a really – population level selection is a deep controversial area, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: it's tough because on the face of it, if that was your genome, it wouldn't get propagated

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: because you would die and then your neighbor who didn't have that would have all the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: kids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think there could be some deep truth there that we're not understanding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What about you yourself as one biological system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Are you afraid of death?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: To be honest, I'm more concerned with – especially now getting older and having helped a couple

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: of people pass.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think about what's a good way to go basically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Like nowadays, I don't know what that is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Living in a facility that tries to stretch you out as long as you can, that doesn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: seem good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's not a lot of opportunities to sacrifice yourself for something useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's not terribly many opportunities for that in modern society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: That's more of – I'm not particularly worried about death itself, but I've seen

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: it happen and it's not pretty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know what a better alternative is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The existential aspect of it does not worry you deeply, the fact that this ride ends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It began – I mean, the ride began.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There was I don't know how many billions of years before that I wasn't around, so

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: that's okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But isn't the experience of life – it almost feels like you're immortal because

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: the way you make plans, the way you think about the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If you look at your own personal rich experience, yes, you can understand, okay, eventually

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's people I love that have died.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Surely, I will die and it hurts and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But like it sure doesn't – it's so easy to get lost in feeling like this is going

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: to go on forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's a little bit like the people who say they don't believe in free will, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I mean, you can say that, but when you go to a restaurant, you still have to pick a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: soup and stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I don't know if I've actually seen that happen at lunch with a well-known philosopher

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and he didn't believe in free will and the waitress came around and he was like, well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: let me see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I was like, what are you doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You're going to choose a sandwich, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So I think it's one of those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think you can know that you're not going to live forever, but you can't – it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: not practical to live that way unless – so you buy insurance and then you do some stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: like that, but mostly I think you just live as if you can make plans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We talked about all kinds of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: We talked about all kinds of embodied minds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What do you think is the meaning of it all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What's the meaning of all the biological lives we've been talking about here on earth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Why are we here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I don't know that that's a well-posed question other than the existential question you posed

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Is that question hanging out with the question of what is consciousness and they're at a

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: retreat somewhere?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Not sure because –

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Sipping piña coladas because they're ambiguously defined.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Maybe – I'm not sure that any of these things really ride on the correctness of our

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: scientific understanding, but just for an example, I've always found it weird that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: people get really worked up to find out realities about their bodies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: For example, do you see them – ex machina, do you see that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: There's this great scene where he's cutting his hand to find out if he's full of cogs.

body.input: That sucks.

body.input: Great.

body.input: It seems to me – I guess I'm with Descartes on this one that whatever the truth ends up

body.input: being of what is consciousness, how it can be conscious, none of that is going to alter

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: my primary experience, which is this is what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If a bunch of molecular networks can do it, fantastic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: If it turns out that there's a non-corporeal soul, great, we'll study that, whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But the fundamental existential aspect of it is if somebody told me today that, yeah,

body.input: But here I am now, so let's –

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: The explanation –

body.input: From a first person perspective – now, scientifically, it's all very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: and how does it happen and whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: But from a first person perspective, I could care less.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: What I learned from any of these scientific facts is, okay, well, I guess then that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: what is sufficient to give me my amazing first person perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: I think if you dig deeper and deeper and get surprising answers to why the hell we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Maybe, maybe.

body.input: I don't know.

body.input: That would be nice.

body.input: On the one hand, you might be right because on the one hand, I don't know what else

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: could possibly give you that guidance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: You would think that it would have to be that or it would have to be science because there

body.input: isn't anything else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: So maybe.

body.input: On the other hand, I am really not sure how you go from any – what they call from an

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: is to an ought, from any factual description of what's going on.

body.input: This goes back to the natural.

body.input: I think whatever has or hasn't happened, we are now in a position to do better if we

body.input: can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: It's really tricky to know how to intellectually deal with a thing that science doesn't currently

body.input: understand.

body.input: Right?

body.input: So like the thing is, if you believe that science solves everything, you can too easily

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: in your mind think our current understanding, like we've solved everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Right.

body.input: and everybody would claim we've solved everything.

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Levin: Biology, Life, Aliens, Evolution, Embryogenesis & Xenobots | Lex Fridman Podcast #325

body.input: Sure.

body.input: vacation versus living there, but that didn't have any effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the decision was made, the majority decision was made to go to Puerto Rico.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In Puerto Rico, the conditions in which the team lived changed significantly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When you're in New York, New York is such a big city that if there's any tension between

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: team members, and inevitably there will be in a competitive sport where everyone's fighting

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: each other, you can kind of bury them in the size of the city because there's so many

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: distractions in New York.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You come in, you do your workout, you go outside and it's New York City.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In Puerto Rico, we lived in a very small local town, Dorado, and most of the athletes were

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: living with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so unlike New York, where there was always a break, you trained together, but when

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: training was over, you went about your life in New York and New Jersey.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: With everyone living in very close proximity to each other, any tensions got magnified

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: because there was no relief from them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You didn't get to get away from people.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you had a problem with someone on the mat, well now you had to live with them for the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: rest of the day and the night.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And this goes on for long periods of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I believe it had the effect of magnifying whatever tensions there were.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In particular, there was a family tension between two brothers which magnified over

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so often it's the case you get two brothers growing up, one older, one younger, and the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: younger one wants to grow and feel somewhat like a young tree underneath a bigger tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And sometimes people just need their space.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there was some unhappiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And as a younger brother, I can understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: As a little tree that had to grow up under a bigger tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So fuck the big tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a lot of aggression I have to work on.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm sorry, unresolved family issues coming out here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm just kidding.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I love you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He doesn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's lying.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So as time went by, these tensions started increasing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They came to a point where it was difficult for them even to be in the training room together.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: At that point, you're starting to, you know, once training takes a hit, then you got to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: start to address these.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The attempts at reconciliation fell through and a decision was made to move to Texas.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I wanted everyone to move as a team.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What I wanted to do was keep the team together as long as the period leading up to ADCC so

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that everyone could train together.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I said, okay, there's problems, but let's just tough it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: One year we moved to Texas.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Let's just go there and keep unity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If some people don't want to train with other people, that's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But I believe that the team would be weakened by breaking apart.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I believe that they had an excellent rapport as training partners.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Their technical level was increasing dramatically.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Many of the younger athletes are really starting to come into their own and really develop

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: well.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so my take on it was, okay, if there's problems, I'm going to be able to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If there's problems, so be it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But let's all just stay together until ADCC 2022 as a unified team.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Go out, prepare yourselves as best you can.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then after that, we can make a decision as to whether we break up or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But that was rejected and the team split.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And they moved to Austin.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: We'd made prior arrangements to go to a local gym and they took that gym and we were left

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: with no gym and more or less homeless in Austin.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: A year out from ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes, this is one year out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So roughly three quarters of the competitive athletes left in one week.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So at that point, that was probably the lowest point because at that point, not only do we

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: not have a place to train, we had very few training partners for the few that had remained.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the main athlete in the team, Gordon Ryan, was going through a particularly bad spell

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: with his unresolved stomach issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And there was doubt as to whether or not he could compete at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And was actively thinking about retiring from the sport.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So maybe not compete ever again, potentially.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So that was a time when it was like, man, the whole program seems to be dead in the water

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: at this point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Most of the competitive athletes were gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There were very few training partners for the few that remained.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the main athlete around whom the group had initially bonded was seemingly out of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: action, possibly permanently.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Where was your mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What were you mentally?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: My thinking is everything bad passes in time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I've had a lot of bad points in my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So my life experience is whenever things seem dark, have patience.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Time will ultimately cure most ills.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Not all of them, but most of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I'm confident that if you give me a new crop of students, I can produce magic.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But it's going to take time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So that confidence was in part a source of strength.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328
