metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And when you explain to people this idea of the pageantry as an illusion, then just as

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: when you watch the magician and you learn the trick, all the magic flies out the window,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: so too with the nervous response.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So that's for the pageantry.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But what about maybe the physical intensity of competition?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Isn't there an extra…

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No, it's the same in every competition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's not like they're twice as strong at NADCC as they are at the IBGF World Championships.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The physical intensity is always pretty much the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They experience it every day in the gym.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And if you go out and you grapple Gordon Ryan, it's not like the next guy you grapple is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: going to be twice as strong as him or twice as fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's going to be a little stronger, a little faster, but not so much so that it completely

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: changes your approach to the game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's not that much difference between the human bodies out there on the stage.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So if you've felt intensity before, you're not going to be shocked by ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But in terms of in training, do you have to try to match the intensity of competition?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No, that would be false.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Every athlete in the gym would be injured.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You can do it for short periods of time, but the training has to be carefully monitored

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in terms of intensity levels.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Remember, we're training seven days a week, a minimum of twice a day.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You've got to keep things under wraps.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Every other workout you can have one of the five rounds can be full power, but not seven

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: days a week, three times a day.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's just going to break bodies.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the full power is just a reminder of…

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's more about skill development.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: For us, it always comes back to skill development.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But what about matching the feeling of the intensity of competition?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, periodically.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Periodically, rarely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But it can't be every single time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Not rarely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's not rare.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Meaning like once a day.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Out of three hours of hard sparring per day, like 15 minutes might be like 100% full power.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's more than enough to get psychologically ready for the intensity of conflict, but won't

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: break your body over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Intensity of conflict, that's well put.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Competition doesn't have that extra level of animosity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's a little bit more conflict than it is…

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It can.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Sometimes there's personality differences.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: For example, Gordon Ryan and Felipe Pena, they admire each other a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They respect each other's skills, but they certainly don't love each other, that's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: for sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there can be certain matchup where there's more intensity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But then there's other matchups where the two athletes come out and it's no more intense

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: than a hard sparring session.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So first of all, because I would love to look at a couple of matches with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And before that, let me say a big thank you to Flow Grappling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: First of all, helping the sport of grappling and jiu-jitsu in general by having organized

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: footage and tournaments that show this sport in its best light to the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And they do an incredible job with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So if you're interested in supporting grappling as a sport, helping it grow, you should definitely

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: support Flow Grappling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Go to their website, sign up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: First of all, ADCC is like the Olympics of grappling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: or you can be invited.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The only people who get invited are either former winners or people in the sport who

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: are just widely recognized superstars who bring some kind of brand value who have proven

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in the past that they have what it takes to compete at that level.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In this format, there are two kinds of matches.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There are weight division matches in which you compete against people, roughly your own

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: size and weight.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There is an open weight where anyone of any size can enter.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So you can have very small people fighting very large people.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There is a second category called a super fight where established champions who have

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: won previous open weight tournaments fight each other in one-off battles, one athlete

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: against another.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So in most of the matches, you will fight repetitively over time towards a gold medal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But in one category, you fight one fight, the so-called super fight, which is usually

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the headline fight of the event.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Traditionally, if you were in the super fight, you could not compete in the weight categories.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It was seen as too risky because you might get injured during the weight category or

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: you might have to fight four very tough fights in a row and get exhausted so that you're

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: ineffective during the main event of the show, the super fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So throughout its history, ADCC has always resisted the idea of an athlete being allowed

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And in the few cases where he didn't finish on legs, then he would simply take his opponents

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: back and that's a very low stress position to occupy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In one case, his opponent deliberately kept his back on the ground to prevent the back

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: take and he just chose mounted position instead.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so he was able to go through his weight division with extremely low energy expenditure,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: which set him up well to go into the finals.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No injuries, very little energy expenditure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now it sounds easy to say that, okay, the strategy worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But in order to get that strategy to work, you have to have one hell of a set of skills.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And we can see those now, would you like to?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, I would love to go through them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I should also mention for people just listening to this, I'll try to commentate

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: on different things we'll look at, but the thing that was made clear is maybe you can

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: speak to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Maybe to you it looks like efficiency, but to me it looked like Gordon was not even trying.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a relaxed aspect to the whole thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So maybe it had to do with saving energy, but he made it look very easy and he made

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the path to submission look very easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So here the first match against an opponent that again looks bigger than him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay, I'll just give an initial comment here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: First you'll see that Gordon elected to sit to the bottom position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The hardest work in submission grappling is when two athletes take the standing position

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and joust for takedowns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's where most of the energy gets burned up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So working on the idea of energy efficiency, let's go out and we chose to sit into guard

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: position and then start looking to access our opponent's back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Because of our opponent's head position, a far side arm drag makes a lot of sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon is able to beat the arm and quickly get behind his opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now the question is going to be getting into a scoring position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's too early to score at this point, but we're just concerned at this stage of energy

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: expenditure and make the other guy work harder than us.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So Gordon did arm drag to the back and now is working on the hooks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The hooks are not particularly important here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He'll use it just to get stability on his opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But interestingly, his opponent here had an interesting strategy too, which was to occupy

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: bottom turtle position and look to get to the critical five-minute demarcation point

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: where points begin to get scored.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His idea, I believe, I'm speculating here based on his actions, was to keep Gordon at

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: bay in a defensive turtle position until a five-minute mark occurred, in which case he

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: would shake Gordon off, walk away and force a takedown battle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: How many people are comfortable in that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And what do you think about the defensive turtle position versus always trying to come

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: back to guard?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Turtle position is the second bottom position of juditsu.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Many people only associate guard position with bottom position in juditsu.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's naive.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's two.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's guard position and turtle position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now as a general rule, guard position offers a much, much greater variety of attacking

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: options than turtle position does.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But that's not to say turtle position absolutely can be an effective bottom position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You can work effectively from there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there's some case to be made that to wait out five minutes, turtle might be...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I personally think against Gordon Ryan, I admire the fellow's courage.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's not easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But there was a logic to what he was doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: People think, oh, he just got his back taken so easily, but he did have a strategy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now did he pick the right person to use that strategy against?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Probably not.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So Gordon is able to break the turtle down, get one hook in.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: At which point is this becoming an extremely controlling position with Gordon in the back?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: At which point are you happy with where it is?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: At this point, it just started to dawn on me at this point, this guy actually had a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: strategy which was to maintain a prone position that he's in now and then shake Gordon off

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: after the five minute mark.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So once that became obvious, then now I'm starting to look at the clock and how close

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If we can take it up to five minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Right now, this guy's only intention is to stop Gordon from strangling him and finish.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay, now the guy's trying to go up and freeze it there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now do you see how he's taking his elbows off the mat in turtle position?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In jiu-jitsu, there's only one reason you take your elbows off the mat from turtle position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's to stand up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So now it's clear at this point what his actual strategy is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's to get up, force a standing confrontation, win a takedown battle and beat Gordon by points.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he did have a strategy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now our counter strategy is always based around the power half Nelson.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is a common move in the sport of wrestling and it's a great way to break people down

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: as they try to stand up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's so heavy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I mean, Gordon is a master of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so there's a power half Nelson that Gordon has on him as the elbows are off the ground

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and knees are off the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's going to return his opponent to the mat.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And as you can see, he's successful in doing so.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And now it's clear what the man's strategy is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I'm calling to Gordon to break him down to a hip.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You put a man on a hip, he can't stand up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon successfully does it, traps the shoulder using that one-on-one grip with his right

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: hand, puts him down to a shoulder and a hip.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That means standing up is no longer an option for his opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now Gordon goes in.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's already scoring because of the turtle position that he's in.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His opponent stays down on his shoulder.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now Gordon's responsibility is to start looking for the stranglehold.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His opponent has basic defensive structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's disciplined with his chin, keeps the chin down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon is a master of tying up defensive arms and penetrating under the chin to get to a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: strangle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And you'll see that shortly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's the trapping of the arm.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Notice that no advanced grips were required.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It was just a spontaneous trap.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's the penetration of the neck.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the arm was trapped with the leg.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yep.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So now he's only got one defensive arm and he's just taking that away with his left hand

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and he gets a one-handed strangle for the finish.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And it looks like not much energy was expanded during that process.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the tournament got off to a very smooth start.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Very little energy expenditure, no injuries and a submission win.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a kind of certain look to Gordon that could be interpreted as nervousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That was an incorrect interpretation?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What do you interpret as nervous behavior?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is part of me is trolling, but sometimes on the surface, confident behavior can look

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: like almost like anger.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And there's a...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon's face had like a vulnerability to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's like when you go to judge confidence, don't look at the face.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Look at the extremities of the body.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's where the truth comes out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You see it in body language and the further from the face and chest, the more honest the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: body becomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Look at the feet and the hands.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What they were...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I mean, that's when you see if people are nervous or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He was very relaxed in the extremities.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: See, you look more confident in this than anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What are you thinking about?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What's going through your head here?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is this the same stuff?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Are you intimidated by the two meatheads, one in a suit and tie, or are you not thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: about that at all?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: For me, it's just about, okay, what's the most efficient path to victory against this

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: particular opponent?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It says, okay, I've done my job.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I've taken them through an extensive fight camp that prepared them for every conceivable

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: situation that they're in.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I've run an efficient warmup.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Their body temperature is perfect.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The elasticity in the muscles is perfect.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: My main role when I corner is I avoid what most people do when they corner, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to be a cheerleader.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Most corner men, they're not corner men, they're cheerleaders.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They're there to express some kind of emotional support to their training partners or their

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: student.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Sometimes they're even worse than cheerleaders.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They express their own emotional fears as the match goes on.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I always believe that 99.5% of the job of the trainer is done, the coach is done when

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the athlete steps their foot on the mat.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: At that point, you shouldn't need me at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Everything I needed to tell you should have been not just told to you, but imprinted into

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Remember, there's 15,000 people in that crowd.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: For half of the match, you're not going to hear a word that I can say.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's too much noise, but you'll hear my voice inside your head because you've heard

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: it so many times over the last 14 weeks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You're sick of hearing it at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Their program know what to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm usually pretty confident.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm also very confident that even in worst case scenarios, they can have effective solutions

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: because they train those worst case scenarios every single day in the gym.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In part, you're there to have a front row seat to analyze what happened so that you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: can take that to the next match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The biggest danger an athlete faces is tunnel vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Sometimes they will hit upon a certain move or strategy and just say, I'm going to go

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: with this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Then there's much easier alternatives.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Because they're so focused on the alternative they've chosen, they get this tunnel vision

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and just focus only on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The most constructive thing the corner man can do is alert them to the presence of time,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: which is very important in an ADCC match because all the scoring is structured by time, and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to alleviate problems associated with tunnel vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay, you're doing this, but if you just did this, it'd be so much easier.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's the main goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Here, this was one of several anticipated matches against the second one against Victor

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Hugo, which is a very tough opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Again, this was a situation where Gordon was considerably outweighed by his opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The main thing here was efficiency.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His opponent elected to avoid the standing position by jumping into guard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So now, Gordon would be in top position this time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He has a very good close guard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Unfortunately, Gordon has very good guard passing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's an excellent guard player, very talented, but Gordon is renowned as the eminent guard

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: passer in the world today.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So it's a tall order to hold Gordon off for a 10-minute match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is there something you can say about this guard passing?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon is making it look very easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's middle distance guard passing here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He eventually passes to mount, I believe, in a very...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What do you run through the sequence where he gets mounted?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I believe he gets mounted twice.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'll back this a little bit further.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's trying to one arm under.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, this is a stacking position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now, normally, we always insist on the idea of getting an advantageous angle first, controlling

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the feet and getting angle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But there's a height advantage that Victor Hugo has here and the length of his legs means

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that he can play very, very wide with his legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So getting an advantageous angle might be difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In these circumstances, it often makes sense to go right up the middle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now, Gordon could just go back for legs because Victor Hugo's legs are so far apart at this

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: point that you could easily isolate a leg and attack that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But Gordon wanted to show off his passing prowess.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Very often, he'll go into a match and say, okay, I'm going to show this skill.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he'll often use it as a demonstration of techniques he teaches in instructional

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: videos.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he wanted to show that he could pass to mount readily on a world champion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Like this part here, this little step.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay, just freeze it right there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Go back one step.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay, you can clearly see that all of his opponent's defensive frames are built on his

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: opponent's left-hand side.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So everything is defense on the left.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But you can see this comes at a price and that price is back exposure on the right-hand

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: side.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You can literally see his opponent's back on that side.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So Gordon's whole game is to place sufficient pressure that the opponent overcompensates

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: on the side of pressure just to set up a quick switch across to the other side.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's the vulnerability, there's the back exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His opponent has to put his back on the ground, switch his back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's a world champion right there on bottom who does a good job of recovering from the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: first danger.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But unfortunately, Gordon has been here a thousand times and just switches his hips

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and kicks out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: A little step.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so you see there's two changes in direction, left, right, in a very short period of time

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that people find very, very hard to keep up with.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now his opponent builds up to an elbow.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's looking to create more and more space from here, but Gordon counters by just stepping

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: over the hips.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's just when you feel like every move, he's doing the right things.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The man on bottom is doing well.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's doing the right things.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But the other guy's just been here too many times and it's just a half second ahead of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: every decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So that going up in the elbow.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon makes it look so easy here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It almost seems like a Victor's out, but this turning of the hips with a arm over the opponent's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: back is able to bring them back down and Gordon takes mount.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Notice how Gordon is never satisfied with the mounted position itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's only satisfied with an extended mounted position where the elbow comes up over the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: shoulder line.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Only then does he show.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a little bit of relief right there, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a little bit of relief.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No, that's the look of a man who's just proved a point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is very Michael Jordan like sticks his tongue out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So yeah, I mean, there's no points at this stage.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He really is going for submission.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then this happens again.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is this the match that wasn't Gordon's?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This was the only match where Gordon didn't finish his opponent by submission.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Was this very frustrating for him?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Was there?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's actually interesting that when he came off the mat, he was visibly frustrated.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He wanted to get a finish.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I think he was more upset about not finishing Victor Hugo than he was delighted by winning

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: his two gold medals.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I think that says a lot about the perfectionism of Gordon Ryan.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Most people would be thrilled to beat one of the great grapplers of this generation

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: decisively in this fashion, but he was not happy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so this is Gordon's third match against Souza.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Who's about Souza?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Another guy who's very big.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, this is different because now we're onto the second day.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Your listeners should be aware that the event occurs over a two day period.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the previous two matches occurred on Saturday.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now we're into Sunday.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now this puts a different context on things.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If we could just freeze it right there, maybe go back one step.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now we're on Sunday morning and the idea is that Gordon will be fighting the biggest fight

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: of his life late that afternoon.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So now we're into the idea of energy conservation.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's okay to have two hard matches on Saturday because you get to rest on Saturday night.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But now Gordon has to beat two people back to back and save energy for the biggest fight

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: of his life on late Sunday afternoon.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So now the emphasis is on a quick win and you can see Gordon Ryan certainly delivers

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now when you go to entangle your opponent's legs, the basic choice you have is between

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: straight ashigarami and cross ashigarami.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In the last five years, cross ashigarami has proven to be statistically the more important

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: of the two.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And as a result, many people have forgotten the value of straight ashigarami based leg

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: locks and undervalued them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon has outstanding heel hooks from both straight and cross positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And his opponent was probably more concerned about the danger of a cross ashigarami, left

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the right leg undefended for far too long.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And as a result, Gordon goes into a very classical ashigarami you would normally expect to see

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: from five or six years ago and gets a very, very quick finish.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So lifts his opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's the ashigarami, the entanglement of one of his opponent's legs with two of his.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now he's got to turn and expose his opponent's heel.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there's an initial off balance to the left to get a defensive reaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The opponent overcompensates, exposes his heel, and then there's the submission.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a danger of a leg being broken here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon has an absolutely ferocious outside heel hook.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Until you've felt it, it's quite different.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the opponent probably before he even felt the heel hook felt the control and that it's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: screwed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That he's screwed there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That he doesn't even want to.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When someone who knows what they're doing gets a bite on your leg like that, you feel

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: it deep inside your knee and ankle tendons immediately.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a sense in which you almost tap.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He got a couple of taps almost as if they're early because the opponent knows.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: People came up to us and said, this guy tapped early.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's like, mm.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No, he knew.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the late would be a big problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Got it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So this is within like 30 seconds, within 10 seconds.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I think it was within 10 seconds.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So this was an excellent example of someone saying, okay, I'm going to conserve energy

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: with a short match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm not just going to go down into a neutral position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm going to directly pull into a leg lock attack from standing position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You don't see that much in heavyweight divisions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's something you see more in the lightweight divisions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So we got to go to the final match of Gordon's within his division, which I think as opposed

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to facing Felipe Pena who lost to Nikki Rod.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Nikki Rod had a great match against Felipe Pena and passed Felipe Pena's guard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I think only the second person in ADCC competition to accomplish that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I believe with a body lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That started as a body lock, but he converted to half guard, top head and arm and passed

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: out of half guard top chest to chest.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I think I listened to Craig Jones sort of interview summarizing what happened in ADCC

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and he briefly mentioned that Nikki Rod might have the best body lock pass that he's ever

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: felt.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So like the way to face Nikki Rod is don't get him, don't let him get the body lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But there's a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you stand up, he's a good wrestler.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there's a dilemma there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You have to sit down to guard, but that goes into his body lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But then if you stand up, now you go into his wrestling skills.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So it's a great dilemma that he has.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that's what in facing Nikki Rod, Gordon Ryan here chooses to...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, if you look at the limbs, there's a relaxation there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: We should also explain some things here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is a finals match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So instead of being 10 minutes long, it's 20 minutes long with the option of a 20 minute

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: overtime.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So this could potentially be a 40 minute match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So you can see why the ADCC people were very concerned about Gordon doing this match because

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: what if this match had gone 40 minutes and then an exhausted Gordon Ryan has to go out

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to fight Andre Galvant who's fresh and ready to maul him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And on top of that is two former teammates.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Who know each other's game very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there was a high likelihood in most people's minds that this would go the distance.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Because when you train with each other for years, every single day in the gym, seven

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: days a week, you get to know each other's tricks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: One big problem here for Nikki Rod is that his body lock guard passing game, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: his main weapon on the ground was taught to him by us.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So it's not like we're going to be taken by surprise by it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328
