body.input: So that must have been figuring in his mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Do you think psychologically for Gordon and psychologically for Nikki Rod, it's tough?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So for him with that body lock, for example, do you think it's tough for him to know what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to do here?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's tough because he would have remembered the outcome of the training sessions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's hard to go up against the guy who used to dominate you in training and then say,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: okay, I'm going to beat him in competition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But can you shut all of that off?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Because it's tough.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Memory is memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You can't lie to yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What do you think about competition?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's been a lot of Olympics bring this out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's been a lot of big upsets at the Olympics.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's something where people find something in them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I mean, judo is a different sport than grappling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But in judo, there's much more room for upset because a mistake in judo will have ramifications

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that will be felt within half a second.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you take the wrong grip in judo, you can be thrown in half a second and there's no

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: recovery.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If your two shoulders hit the mat with momentum, it's over, it's done.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In jiu-jitsu, you could, especially in ADCC where there's no points in the first five

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: minutes, you could get taken down and mounted by your opponent and still win.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You can recover from a bad start.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In judo, boxing, kickboxing, MMA, you get hit, there's no recovery time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You just get swarmed on.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And jiu-jitsu is a much more forgiving sport where you can make a series of blunders and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: you just recover from them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You don't make a series of blunders in boxing, you're unconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's the blunder case, but there's also been just people where it's their day.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I mean, again, maybe it's romanticizing the notion, but there's been some epic performances

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in Olympic wrestling, in Olympic judo.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: As an example, Satoshi Ishii, he had a 2008 performance.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: We talked about the All Japan and all that kind of stuff, but the Olympics, he destroyed

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: everybody on this path to the Olympic gold medal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's when Teddy Renear was also competing, he got the bronze.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You could say he was at that time the best in the world also, but some people have.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, but I think it would be very fair to say he was the best in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Think about the people he beat to win three All Japan championships.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He beat Kosei Inoue, he beat Keiji Suzuki, they were Olympic champions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He was already...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So you don't believe in free will?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I don't believe that a person can walk on stage and be better than what they are supposed

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You have a skill level at set in stone.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is your skill level.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You don't just go on stage and suddenly your skill level gets here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What you do have is a situation where you have a skill level, okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Another opponent has a higher skill level, but he runs into confidence issues so that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: he only uses a small percentage of his actual skills.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then he will fall below someone who is technically lower on the skill scale than

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: he is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That can happen, but you can't just magically acquire skills by stepping on stage.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, but all of us are able to fall in confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the question becomes who manages that fall best?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that can create upsets.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So you don't think Gordon could have fallen in confidence against a former teammate when

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the pressure is so high?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There was just no basis for a fall to occur.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You said he doesn't have confidence issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What do you attribute that to?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's because he never loses in the gym.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's nothing in the, there's no experience that he's had that would make him say, I shouldn't

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: be this confident.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So it's the physical, it's like we talked about mental preparation.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Don't get me wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If Gordon lost 20 matches in a row, of course his confidence would drop because experience

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: is now, there's going to be a psychological dissonance between his experience, his recent

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: experience and what he believes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you believe you're the best in the world, you just lost 20 matches.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: At some point, reality is going to break in.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But if you're just never losing in competition, dominating people in the gym, then there's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: nothing in your experience that would shake your confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Can I ask you this just in a small tangent?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Why is Gordon Ryan so good?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So we're looking at, you've trained a lot of special athletes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You're a special human being yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I could just look at human history.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a lot of, not a lot, there's some special humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It seems like Gordon Ryan is one of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I totally agree with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Can you try to like dissect?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's what I meant when I said I had many students, but only one Gordon Ryan.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Like I've taught many, many people, but they don't all have his skill level.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there's an obvious elephants in the room here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What distinguishes him from other athletes?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Great question.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'll try and give an answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: More than anyone else that I've ever taught, he has a memory for things that were taught

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He has an ability to recall information that is extraordinary compared with other people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in the room.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So that's definitely a big part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Secondly, he has a pride in technique and technical prowess that will not allow him

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to settle for anything less than perfection.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he will hate himself when there is imperfection.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there is a love of excellence and a hatred of anything less than excellence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He has an ability to pull the trigger when opportunity arises, which is truly extraordinary.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Many people know what to do, but when the moment comes, they back off and they'll doubt

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If Gordon sees the opportunity, the trigger pulls every time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So can I just link on that briefly?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a few times where he gets a little bit of an advantage and he just chases it

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to get a big, like Andre Gavau.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You get, it's like there's a dance and you get one step ahead and he's able to chase

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that, get a little glimmer of the back and he's able to chase that all the way to back

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: control.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So that is that kind of the trigger that you're referring to?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It runs deeper than that too.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's the idea that good athletes are greedy athletes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When they see a small opportunity, they try and get as big a bite of it as possible so

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that the mantra that we always have in training, if you can see the back, you can take the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And if Gordon sees an inch of your back, you know that's the direction he's going to be

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: going.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If your far shoulder is within an inch of the floor, he's going to be mounting you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If your shoulder comes off the floor, he'd be on your back on the other side.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's a maximalist with opportunity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's not satisfied with, oh, let me get a good enough outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's like I want the maximal outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So when you combine all these things together, an ability to recall information, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: just far superior to anyone else I've ever coached, an ability to work in the training

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: room towards not just good technique, but excellent technique.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The confidence to pull the trigger whenever the opportunity arises.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: A maximalist mindset where it's never enough to have a good enough outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's always going to be the best possible outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the fifth element, which I believe is very, very important, is extraordinary depth

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in his technical prowess.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In particular, with regards his defensive acumen.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Everyone looks at Gordon and focuses on his offensive prowess because they see him dominate

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: other athletes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But what they don't see is what I see every day in the gym where he works from impossibly

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: bad defensive position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Someone locked in on a full heel hook on his body and a full jujutsu kata miyamba in a complete

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: pin mounted with Gordon's two arms stretched out over his head in what looks like a hopeless

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: position and Gordon will work in these positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And of course, because it's such a bad position, sometimes he'll have to tap.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But he just works so relentlessly in these bad positions that when he steps on stage,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: he's like, if this guy got the worst possible position on me, there's nothing he could do

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And within 30 seconds, I could turn it around on him and win this match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That gives his game an overall breadth and depth, which is very, very hard to deal with.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It means there's no obvious weak point where you can just say, okay, I'm going to attack

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: him here and use this strategy to beat him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that goes back to his confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The reason why most people lack confidence is because they fear bad outcomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you're a strong guard player, you've got an excellent guard, but you're terrified of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: leg locks and your opponent has strong leg locks, you will shut down your own guard and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: won't play as freely and well as you normally do because you're afraid of the leg lock danger.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You'll pull your feet in, you'll play a very conservative guard game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But if you had extremely adept leg lock defense, then you just play with all the confidence

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: you normally do from guard position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon puts himself in that situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's so defensively sound that it translates into his offensive confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When you talk about memory recall, which is interesting, I can't help but see parallels

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: between him and Magnus Carlsen, who's a chess player, who's the number one in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: arguably the best ever, certainly the best ever if you just look at absolute numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The chess has the luxury of having a rating, which you cannot have in Jiu Jitsu because

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: it's a game of human chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Chess is just a board game, so you can actually calculate the probability that you could win.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he has the highest ELO rating ever and he's maintained that rating.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Without competing against the number two in the world, he could just prove that he's the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: number one in the world for many years.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Anyway, there's certain similarities.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: One is ability to recall.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So memory recall of information is fascinatingly good.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The other one is not so much a love for perfection, which is something you mentioned, but the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: flip side of that, which is what you also mentioned, is the hate of imperfection.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now, in the case of Magnus, it almost creates a level of anxiety for him that's almost destructive.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the thing he seems to hate the most is imperfection against people he knows are worse

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: than him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the thing he loves is competing against people that are close to skill level, or the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: favorite is people who might actually be better than him, especially in certain positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He loves competing against them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He hates competing against people that are still, from the perspective of everyone else,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: what are called super grandmasters, so top three in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But he knows he's much better than them and the anxiety of being not perfect against those

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: people.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's why he, I don't know if you're paying attention, but he stepped away.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's not going to defend his world championship because he hates the anxiety of playing people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: worse than him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He figures they would somehow make him look bad?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No, for him, at least the language he uses, it's just not fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he likes having fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: To him, it was fun to win, no matter the skill level, the world championship the first time,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: but then defending it is a very grueling process.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: With classical chess, you play these many hours, it could be seven hour long games.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And on top of that, he really hates the fact that it's only, I forget what it is, but it's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: single digit number of games.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He says it's low sample.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I can't, I would like to play 20, 30, 40, 50 games if we're going to do it this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But then they're too long, it's going to take too long.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he really emphasizes the fun of it and the clear demonstration of who's the best.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now, chess is an interesting game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's probably different than grappling because it's been played for centuries.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there's this giant body of people that are playing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's other Gordon Rians out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Imagine a world where there's multiple Gordon Rians or something like that, different dimensions,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: but you have sharks everywhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so there is fun to be had even at the very, very, very, very top.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But the memory recall is the thing that stands out and the hate of imperfection, more intense

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: than anybody else in the game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That takes us back to the final.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Ah, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So here Gordon is facing Nicky Rod, former training partner.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And again, the intention here is this has to be put in the context that Gordon will

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: be fighting the greatest ACC grappler of all time in a few hours after this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So what we're looking for is a quick resolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Still the shortest possible match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now there's a complicating factor here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Nicky Rod was a wrestler before he was a Jiu-Jitsu player.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: On paper, the way his route to win is via wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's not going to be able to submit Gordon Ryan and he's not going to be able to pass

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: his guard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he has to win by wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In the ADCC finals, you cannot sit to guard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the approach that Gordon used earlier that we saw on video cannot be used in the finals.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon must wrestle his opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So on the way out, Gordon and I were talking and we'd had discussions obviously during

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the camp.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What's the appropriate thing to do here?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And there had been some matches earlier in the event where it was becoming obvious that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: stalling was being heavily punished by referees.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I said to Gordon on the way out, just give him your leg.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Let him take you down because in the first 10 minutes of the finals, takedowns don't

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: score anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There are no means of scoring the first 10 minutes, but you can't sit to guard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That will award you a negative point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I said, just let Nicky Rod take you down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he's like, Nicky Rod's not going to take the bait.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I said, if he doesn't, I'll call him for stalling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then Craig Jones also commented after the fact is, I don't know why Nicky Rod took

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the bait.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So if we see the start of the match, you see Gordon comes out and offers a leg.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now it's not that Nicky Rod is smart.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He knows what's happening here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And what's he going to do?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Stall for 10 minutes and get like five stalling calls put against them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So Gordon gives him the take down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That way they go to the ground immediately with no effort.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the match now favors Gordon because Gordon is significantly more skilled on the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The question is, how can we make this match as short as possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And as is so often the case, the answer comes back to legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So for people just listening to this, Gordon is in an open guard and Nicky Rod appears

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to be trying to keep his hips away from Gordon's legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The big Nicky Rod knows there's a danger here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's elected to go to his knees that will set up his favorite body lock passes and it

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: will in some ways mitigate some of the dangers associated with leg locks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So Gordon's whole thing is how am I going to get my body weight underneath him?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He has a choice between linear entries where he enters between his opponent's knees and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: circular entries where he inverts and spins underneath his opponent to get under a center

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: of gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is there a way for somebody to try to get a body lock without giving Gordon an opportunity

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to get under them?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Well, the body lock is an excellent way to shut down leg lock entries if you can get

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to the body lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But you can see Gordon's very, very disciplined with his elbow and knee position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His elbows and knees are working in a position where it's very, very hard for his opponent

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to access his waist.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That shoulder is always either across the hip or in front of the shoulder.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Sorry, his knee is either in front of the shoulder or in front of the hip.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And we're one minute into the match and just if I were to look at the video player here,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: it appears that the match is over soon.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I guess Nikki Rodd is facing this, I need to get close in order to do the body lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the closer you get, the more danger there is to let Gordon get under you and get the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: leg control.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now, they're starting to get close here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon's going to try and get his head underneath his opponent, make a circular entry into the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's clearing his opponent's head out of the way by faking the arm drag on the far side,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the first move that he used against his first opponent earlier in the tournament.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And there's the leg spins underneath it, goes circular, rotates through, gets his body weight

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: underneath his opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now he's going to trip him down to the mat.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now I believe Nikki Rodd tries to pull out his foot here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And Craig also said that Nikki Rodd has gotten used to be able to pull that foot out from

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: anybody and that he was very surprised at the grip that Gordon was able to actually

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: hold on.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I just want to comment.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm just parroting commentary from the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you look at what's happening here, if you just freeze it, you'll see that Gordon, like

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: any good leg locker, will always treat his opponent's foot like a knot at the end of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the rope.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Just as you slide down a rope, if there's a knot at the end, your hand will catch.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So too with the human leg.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When they go to extract by pulling, you just keep your fist as close to your shoulder as

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: possible and narrow the gap.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The foot will always catch.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The failure that many people have is they let their hand drift away from their own shoulder.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so there's room for the foot to extract.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But you'll see Gordon's extremely disciplined with thumb close to his own shoulder, which

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: creates a situation that's very, very hard just to simply pull your foot out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You're focusing on the knot of the foot.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Also, it's very early in the match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's very little sweat.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Both athletes are still pretty dry.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now Gordon has to climb the leg and now he's already captured his opponent's shoelace.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's the heel exposure coming up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Niki Rod already knows things are getting bad and there's the win.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Actually the comment I made, I guess, was from a little bit earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's an earlier time where Niki Rod was trying to pull out the foot and the Gordon

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: is able to hold onto the knot, which is interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now that was a brilliant day's work by Gordon Ryan.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's had two matches against opponents considerably bigger and stronger than himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the time of the two matches can be measured in, I think, less than two minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's done what he set out to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No injuries, no exhaustion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's beaten four guys back to back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: All of whom are excellent athletes with minimal energy expenditure and he's ready to go on

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to his super fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that's against one of the greatest, arguably for a long time, really, really up there jiu-jitsu

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: practitioners, competitors, grappling no-gi competitors of all time, which is Andre Gavard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Andre Gavard is almost certainly at this point the greatest ADCC competitor of all time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: One more super fight than anyone else by a landslide.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So if I may just read a few words you've written on Instagram about this match, about Andre

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gavard, on greatness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: How great you become in any given endeavor will always be assessed by the degree of difficulty

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: of the barriers you had to overcome to get to the top.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Just as the lion became king of the jungle not by living among sheep, but by dominating

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: a world of elephants, hyenas, buffalo, leopards, crocodiles.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So too the greatness of an athlete will be determined not just by his own ability, but

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: by the greatness of the athletes he faces.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Thus in his quest for greatness, Gordon Ryan owes a debt to the greatness of his toughest

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: opponent Andre Gavard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And you go on to sing him praises.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that introduces this match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There was an interesting moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I didn't even listen to the words exchanged, but because I had the great fortune of sitting

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: next to Hydra Gracie, there was this fascinating moment before the match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I can't believe Gordon is sufficiently relaxed to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But he walked up to Hydra Gracie and had a discussion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You face Andre Gavard before.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What are your suggestions?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And they've talked to back and forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They brainstormed ideas like minutes before the match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And it was just a beautiful moment of like, I don't know, like the Tiger Woods and Michael

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Jordan talking to each other, something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I mean, I wonder how much brainstorming there really was and how much was it just kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: like spiritual inspiration or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I think it's more spiritual inspiration.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He looks up to Hydra as a very close friend and mentor of mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I always tell my athletes, look to Hydra as your example.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is a guy who always fought for the finish.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He tried to express the highest ideal of jiu-jitsu, which is control leading to submission in

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: every match he was ever in.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He even lost matches on tactics against people that he could easily have defeated if he adopted

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: a different tactic.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But he always insisted on victory by submission that defined his career and made him who he

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: was.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I always try to have my athletes emulate him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So what was the strategy going into this match?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What were you thinking?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What were you thinking?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: For Andre Galvant, there's a sense in which Andre Galvant had to fight literally the perfect

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: match to win this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is a match that's going to be 20 minutes long and potentially 40 minutes long.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Andre Galvant cannot win by submission.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon's submission dominance here is just too great.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It would be exceedingly difficult for him to win on the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon's ground positional game is just too advanced.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so for Andre Galvant, if he was going to win, it was going to be in a standing wrestling

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: exchange where most people assessed him as having a measure of superiority over Gordon

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Ryan.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The problem is that it's hard to just keep a potentially 40 minute match off the ground

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that whole time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's very, very difficult indeed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he would have had to fight literally the perfect tactical match to make it happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he would have to do it without getting called for stalling points.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon has the luxury that if at any point they go to the ground, he has complete dominance.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But Gordon too has a problem that he can't pull guard without being penalized.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And if Andre Galvant can play this tactical game of forcing Gordon to pull guard and then

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: staying at a distance where he doesn't, he's doing enough action not to get called for

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: stalling, but not so much to engage with the dangerous Gordon Ryan on the ground, then

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: it's feasible he could have won.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But it would have been, as I said, it would have required the most perfect application

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and integration of technique and tactics that he's capable of.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Which intimidation was there?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Or are these assets already beyond that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When you say intimidation, be more precise.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Do you think there was some degree, if you were just to empathize with Andre Galvant,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: do you think there's some degree in which Gordon was in his head?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Because of the trash talk leading up to certain events, because of the level of dominance

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that Gordon has shown in this competition and in the months and years leading up to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Also the fact that Andre Galvant is also a coach of a large team.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there's some pressure to demonstrate to the team that the old line still got it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I can't speak for Andre, but I know for Gordon, it's hard to be intimidated when you know

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the other guy has no method of finishing you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It just takes so much pressure off.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When you just go in there saying, there's literally no way this guy can finish me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And there's no way this guy can pin and control me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I can't be finished.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I can't be pinned and controlled.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The only way I can lose this is if this guy plays a tactical game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So in his best case scenario, I lose by tactical game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But from Andre's perspective, it's like if I make one screw up, this kid could finish

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You can see which way the intimidation game goes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now for the start, things get interesting here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: We've already said, if you could just freeze it right there, Andre's only realistic path

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to victory is standing grappling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That would require him to take Gordon down presumably multiple times after the first

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: 10 minutes and not be taken down at all by Gordon.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So it's a tall order.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's possible, but difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And here's where things get interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I told Gordon before the match, just go out and offer him the leg.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Same way he did with Nicky Rod.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that's where things get interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I must say that I loved what Andre Galvant did at the start of this match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's a little crazy here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There was just so much energy in the room at this point that his hand fighting got out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: For people just listening, there's a bit of hard slapping.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, that's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That could be considered a strike.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328
